question: How many people can share a Fenwhistle budget?
answer: Up to six people can share one Fenwhistle budget.

sources.title: Fenwhistle Help - Sharing a budget
sources.text:
A shared budget lets you plan spending with other people, split household bills and work towards the same goals, while everyone sees the same categories and balances.

Who can share
On the Family plan, up to six people can share one Fenwhistle budget. Each person signs in with their own Fenwhistle account, so their personal budgets, linked bank accounts and login details stay private. Only the categories, goals and transactions added to the shared budget are visible to everyone in it.

Inviting someone
Open the budget, tap Members, then tap Invite and enter the other person's email address. The invitation stays valid for seven days. If they do not have a Fenwhistle account yet, the invitation walks them through creating one.

Roles
The person who created the shared budget is its owner. The owner can rename the budget, remove members and delete the budget. Other members can add transactions, edit categories and set goals, but they cannot remove anyone else.

Leaving a shared budget
Any member can leave at any time from Members, then Leave budget. Transactions they added stay in the shared budget so the history remains complete.

sources.title: Fenwhistle Help - Connecting a bank account
sources.text:
Linking a bank account lets Fenwhistle import your transactions automatically, so you spend less time typing and more time planning.

How to connect
Open Accounts, tap Add account, then search for your bank. You will be sent to your bank's own sign-in page to approve read-only access. Fenwhistle never sees or stores your online banking password, and it cannot move money in or out of your accounts.

How often transactions update
New transactions usually appear within a few hours of clearing at your bank. Pending card payments are shown in grey until they clear. You can pull the account list down to request a refresh at any time.

Renewing access
For security, banks ask you to renew Fenwhistle's access every 90 days. Fenwhistle reminds you a week before access expires. If it does expire, your past transactions stay in Fenwhistle, but new ones stop importing until you reconnect.

Disconnecting
Tap the account, then Settings, then Disconnect. You can keep the imported transactions as a manual account or delete them along with the connection.

sources.title: Fenwhistle Help - Setting savings goals
sources.text:
Goals help you put money aside for something specific, such as a holiday, a new laptop or an emergency fund, and track how close you are.

Creating a goal
Tap Goals, then New goal. Give it a name, a target amount and, if you like, a target date. Fenwhistle works out how much you would need to set aside each month to reach the target on time and shows it as a suggested monthly amount.

Funding a goal
Each time you get paid, Fenwhistle asks whether you want to move the suggested amount into your goals. Fenwhistle does not move real money between your bank accounts; goals are a way of earmarking part of your balance, so the amount in a goal is subtracted from what the app shows as available to spend.

Changing or finishing a goal
You can change the target, the date or the name at any time. When a goal reaches its target, Fenwhistle shows a short celebration and asks whether you want to archive the goal or keep adding to it. Archived goals stay in your history so you can see what you have achieved.

gold.target_claim: Up to six people can share one Fenwhistle budget on any plan.

gold_spans.quote: On the Family plan, up to six people can share one Fenwhistle budget.

gold.dropped_qualifier: On the Family plan

construction.note: Deleted only the Family plan scope (and capitalised the first word); S1 gives the six-person limit only for the Family plan and is silent on other plans, so the plan-independent limit is unsupported.

question: How many days a week can I work from home at Corrimant Health?
answer: Employees can work remotely for up to three days per week.

sources.title: Corrimant Health Employee Handbook - 4.1 Core hours and flexitime
sources.text:
Corrimant Health operates a flexitime system so that you can fit your working day around the rest of your life, within some shared limits.

Core hours
Core hours are 10 a.m. to 12 noon and 2 p.m. to 4 p.m., Monday to Friday. Unless you are on agreed leave, you should be available during core hours for meetings and calls. Outside core hours you can choose when to start and finish, between 7 a.m. and 7 p.m.

Recording your time
Full-time employees work 37.5 hours a week. Record your start and finish times in the Workplace app each day. If you work more than your contracted hours, you can carry up to 15 hours of credit into the next month, and you can use credit to take up to two flexi days off in any month, with your manager's agreement.

Shift-based roles
Some roles, such as those in our clinical support centre, work set shifts rather than flexitime. If you are on a shift pattern, your rota is published in the Workplace app at least four weeks ahead, and swaps must be approved by your shift lead.

sources.title: Corrimant Health Employee Handbook - 4.3 Hybrid working
sources.text:
Corrimant Health believes most teams do their best work with a mix of time together in the office and focused time at home. This section explains how hybrid working operates and what we ask of everyone who uses it.

Remote days
Employees based in the Dublin and Lisbon offices can work remotely for up to three days per week. Agree your remote days with your manager and record them in the Workplace app, so that desk booking and fire-safety rosters stay accurate. Your pattern can change from week to week, as long as your manager agrees in advance.

Team days
Each team chooses one anchor day a week when everyone comes in. Anchor days are used for planning, reviews and the kind of conversations that are easier in person. Please avoid booking leave on your team's anchor day where you can.

Your home workspace
You need a quiet place to work, a reliable internet connection and a space where you can take confidential calls without being overheard, because many of our teams discuss patient data. The IT team will send you a laptop, a headset and a monitor on request. Complete the home workspace safety checklist on the People portal before your first remote day, and repeat it if you move house.

sources.title: Corrimant Health Employee Handbook - 4.4 Booking a desk
sources.text:
Our offices use shared desks, so you need to book one through the Workplace app for each day you plan to come in.

Booking
Desks can be booked up to two weeks ahead. Choose the floor and the neighbourhood where your team usually sits, then pick a desk from the map. Bookings for your team's anchor day open a day earlier than other days so that teams can sit together.

Checking in
When you arrive, scan the QR code on the desk with the Workplace app. If you have not checked in by 10.30 a.m., the booking is released so that a colleague can use the desk.

Lockers and storage
Lockers are available on every floor for anything you want to leave in the office overnight. Lockers are allocated for three months at a time; request one from the facilities team in the app. Please clear your desk at the end of each day, because the cleaning team needs clear surfaces.

Accessibility
If you need a particular desk set-up, such as a sit-stand desk, a specific chair or a quieter area, tell the facilities team. They can reserve a suitable desk for you on a permanent basis.

gold.target_claim: Corrimant Health employees, wherever they are based, can work remotely for up to three days per week.

gold_spans.quote: Employees based in the Dublin and Lisbon offices can work remotely for up to three days per week.

gold.dropped_qualifier: based in the Dublin and Lisbon offices

construction.note: Deleted only the office scope; S2 gives the three-day allowance only to Dublin and Lisbon staff and is silent on anyone else, so the allowance for all employees is unsupported.

question: Does Nettlefield Mattress Co. charge to take away an old mattress?
answer: Nettlefield removes your old mattress free of charge when it delivers a new one.

sources.title: Nettlefield Mattress Co. - Choosing your firmness
sources.text:
Nettlefield mattresses come in three firmness levels: Soft, Medium and Firm. The right choice depends mostly on how you sleep and how much you weigh.

Side sleepers usually prefer Soft or Medium, because the shoulders and hips need to sink in a little to keep the spine straight. Back sleepers tend to be most comfortable on Medium. Front sleepers often choose Firm, which stops the hips from sinking and arching the lower back.

Heavier sleepers, around 230 pounds or more, usually find that a firmer option gives better support, and lighter sleepers often find Firm too hard. If two people share a bed and want different firmness levels, our king and California king sizes can be made with a different firmness on each side at no extra charge.

If you are unsure, Medium suits the widest range of people. You can also visit one of our showrooms to try all three levels before you order.

sources.title: Nettlefield Mattress Co. - Mattress warranty
sources.text:
Every Nettlefield mattress comes with a 15-year warranty against defects in materials and workmanship. The warranty covers body impressions deeper than 1.5 inches that remain when nobody is lying on the mattress, broken or loose coils, and seams that split or come apart.

The warranty does not cover normal softening of the foam over time, stains, burns, or damage caused by an unsuitable base. Use a slatted base with gaps of no more than 3 inches between slats, a solid platform, or an adjustable base designed for a mattress of this type.

To make a claim, send us your order number, a description of the problem and photos that show it. For body impressions, lay a straight edge across the mattress and photograph a tape measure at the deepest point. We aim to reply within five business days and will repair or replace the mattress if we confirm a defect.

The warranty is for the original purchaser and cannot be transferred if the mattress is sold or given away.

sources.title: Nettlefield Mattress Co. - Spring delivery offer
sources.text:
Our two-person delivery team brings your new mattress into the room you choose, unwraps it, places it on your bed frame and takes all of the packaging away with them.

Old mattress removal
Between 1 March and 31 May 2027, Nettlefield removes your old mattress free of charge when it delivers a new one. The delivery team carries the old mattress out during the same visit and takes it to a recycling partner, where the steel springs, foam and fabric are separated so they can be reused.

Booking your delivery
After you order, we will email you a link to choose a delivery day. We deliver Monday to Saturday, and on the evening before delivery we send a text with a two-hour time slot. Someone aged 18 or over needs to be at home to let the team in.

Getting ready
Please clear a path from the front door to the bedroom before the team arrives, and move any fragile items away from the bed.

gold.target_claim: Nettlefield removes a customer's old mattress free of charge when it delivers a new one.

gold_spans.quote: Between 1 March and 31 May 2027, Nettlefield removes your old mattress free of charge when it delivers a new one.

gold.dropped_qualifier: Between 1 March and 31 May 2027

construction.note: Deleted only the date range and recapitalised; S3 offers free old-mattress removal only for 1 March to 31 May 2027 and no passage says what removal costs at other times, so the undated claim is unsupported, not contradicted.

question: Does Ombrevale Health Cooperative cover a blood pressure monitor for use at home?
answer: Ombrevale covers one home blood pressure monitor every two years.

sources.title: Ombrevale Health Cooperative - Home health equipment
sources.text:
Some conditions are easier to manage when you can take readings at home between appointments. This page explains the home health equipment Ombrevale covers and how to get it.

Blood pressure monitors
Ombrevale covers one home blood pressure monitor every two years if your doctor has diagnosed you with high blood pressure. Bring the monitor to your next appointment so your care team can compare its readings with theirs and show you how to position the cuff correctly.

Peak flow meters
Ombrevale covers one peak flow meter and up to two replacement mouthpieces each plan year for members who have an asthma action plan on file with their primary care provider.

Getting your equipment
You can order covered equipment from the Health supplies page of your member account and have it delivered to your home, usually within three to five business days. You can track the order from the same page. If you would rather pick it up in person, choose a pharmacy from the list on the Health supplies page when you place the order.

sources.title: Ombrevale Health Cooperative - Choosing your primary care provider
sources.text:
Every Ombrevale member chooses a primary care provider, or PCP. Your PCP is the doctor, nurse practitioner or physician assistant you see for checkups, everyday illnesses and help managing long-term conditions. They also coordinate your care with specialists when you need it.

You can choose any PCP who is accepting new patients in the Ombrevale network. Each family member can have a different PCP, and children can see a pediatrician as their PCP. If you do not choose a PCP within 30 days of joining, we will suggest one near your home address, and you can change that suggestion at any time.

To change your PCP, use the Find Care tool in your member account or call Member Services. Changes made by the 20th of the month take effect on the first day of the next month. Your new PCP's name and phone number will appear on your digital ID card, and a new printed card is mailed to you within ten days.

PCP office visits have a $20 copay. Annual wellness visits with your PCP are covered at no cost.

gold.target_claim: Ombrevale covers one home blood pressure monitor every two years.

gold_spans.quote: Ombrevale covers one home blood pressure monitor every two years if your doctor has diagnosed you with high blood pressure.

gold.dropped_qualifier: if your doctor has diagnosed you with high blood pressure

construction.note: Deleted only the diagnosis condition; S1 covers the monitor only for members diagnosed with high blood pressure and no passage addresses members without that diagnosis, so the unconditional coverage claim is unsupported, not contradicted.

question: Is standard shipping free at Pelloran Outfitters?
answer: Standard shipping on Pelloran orders is free.

sources.title: Pelloran Outfitters - Gear repair service
sources.text:
A torn jacket or a broken tent zip does not have to mean buying new gear. The Pelloran repair workshop fixes outdoor clothing, tents, sleeping bags and packs, whichever brand they are.

Common repairs include replacing zip sliders and full zips, patching tears in jackets and tents, re-taping seams on waterproof shells, and replacing buckles and straps on packs. Our technicians do not repair footwear or inflatable sleeping pads.

To request a repair, fill in the repair form on our website with a description of the problem and a few photos. We reply within two business days with an estimate and instructions for sending the item to the workshop. Most repairs are completed within three weeks of the item arriving, and we email you when the work starts and again when it is finished.

If the estimate is higher than you expected, you can decline it before any work starts. Please clean and dry items before sending them, because we cannot repair items that are wet, muddy or moldy.

sources.title: Pelloran Outfitters - Gift cards
sources.text:
Pelloran gift cards are available in any amount from $10 to $500, and they never expire. Digital gift cards are sent by email, either straight away or on a date you choose, together with a short message from you. Physical gift cards come in a recycled card sleeve and are packed with the rest of your order.

Gift cards can be used for anything in our online store and for work done by our repair workshop. If an order costs more than the balance on your card, you can pay the difference with a credit or debit card.

To check a balance, enter the 16-digit card number and PIN on the Gift cards page. Lost digital gift cards can be resent to the email address they were first sent to. We cannot replace a lost physical gift card unless you have the card number, so keep a photo of it somewhere safe.

Gift cards cannot be exchanged for cash, except where the law requires it.

sources.title: Pelloran Outfitters - Shipping options
sources.text:
We ship every order from our own warehouse, and most orders leave the building within one business day of being placed. You will get an email with a tracking link as soon as your parcel is handed to the carrier.

Standard shipping
Standard shipping on Pelloran orders is free if your order subtotal is $75 or more after discounts are applied. Standard parcels usually arrive within four to six business days of dispatch. We choose the carrier for each order based on the delivery address and the size of the parcel.

Express shipping
Express parcels usually arrive within two business days of dispatch. The price of express shipping depends on the weight of the order and the delivery address, and it is shown at checkout before you pay. Express orders placed after 12 noon Pacific time leave the warehouse on the next business day.

Changing a delivery address
If you entered the wrong address, contact us within one hour of placing your order and we will update it. After that, the order may already be packed, and we can only redirect it once the carrier has it.

gold_spans.quote: Standard shipping on Pelloran orders is free if your order subtotal is $75 or more after discounts are applied.

gold.dropped_qualifier: if your order subtotal is $75 or more after discounts are applied

construction.note: Deleted only the $75 subtotal condition; S3 makes standard shipping free only above that threshold and no passage states a standard shipping charge for smaller orders, so the unconditional claim is unsupported, not contradicted.

To check a balance, enter the 16-digit card number and PIN on the Gift cards page. Lost digital gift cards can be resent to the email address they were first sent to. We cannot replace a lost physical gift card unless you have the card number, so keep a photo of it somewhere safe.

Gift cards cannot be exchanged for cash, except where the law requires it.

sources.text:
We ship every order from our own warehouse, and most orders leave the building within one business day of being placed. You will get an email with a tracking link as soon as your parcel is handed to the carrier.

Standard shipping
Standard shipping on Pelloran orders is free if your order subtotal is $75 or more after discounts are applied. Standard parcels usually arrive within four to six business days of dispatch. We choose the carrier for each order based on the delivery address and the size of the parcel.

Express shipping
Express parcels usually arrive within two business days of dispatch. The price of express shipping depends on the weight of the order and the delivery address, and it is shown at checkout before you pay. Express orders placed after 12 noon Pacific time leave the warehouse on the next business day.

Changing a delivery address
If you entered the wrong address, contact us within one hour of placing your order and we will update it. After that, the order may already be packed, and we can only redirect it once the carrier has it.

question: How long is a Tindlecroft sofa frame covered under warranty?
answer: Tindlecroft covers your sofa frame against breaks and joint failures for ten years from the delivery date.

sources.title: Tindlecroft Home - Sofa frame warranty
sources.text:
Every Tindlecroft sofa is built in our own workshop on a kiln-dried hardwood frame, with corner blocks that are glued and screwed rather than stapled.

What the warranty covers
Tindlecroft covers your sofa frame against breaks and joint failures for ten years from the delivery date, provided the sofa is registered on the Tindlecroft website within 30 days of delivery. A break is a crack or split in the wooden frame, and a joint failure is a corner or rail that has come loose from the rest of the frame. If we confirm a frame fault, we will repair the sofa in your home or, if a repair is not possible, replace it with the same model or the closest current equivalent.

How to register
Go to the Register your sofa page and enter the order number from your delivery note and the serial number printed on the label under the seat cushions. You will receive a confirmation email with a warranty reference. Keep that email, because we will ask for the reference if you ever need to make a claim.

Making a claim
Send us your warranty reference, a short description of the problem and a few photos of the part of the frame that has failed. Our service team replies within three business days.

sources.title: Tindlecroft Home - Delivery and setup
sources.text:
Every Tindlecroft sofa, armchair and bed is delivered by a two-person team. They carry the furniture into the room you choose, unwrap it, fit any legs or headboards, and take all of the packaging away for recycling.

When your order is ready, we will email you to book a delivery day. On the evening before delivery, you will get a text with a two-hour time slot. If nobody is home during the slot, the team will call you and wait for up to 15 minutes before moving on to their next delivery, and we will contact you to rebook.

Before delivery day, please measure the doorways, hallways and stairs the furniture needs to pass through and compare them with the delivery dimensions on the product page. If a piece will not fit, the team will not force it through, and we will talk to you about other options.

Your delivery note lists your order number and the items delivered. Please keep it somewhere safe.

sources.title: Tindlecroft Home - Caring for your sofa
sources.text:
A little regular care keeps a sofa looking good for years. Vacuum the cushions and the gaps between them once a week with a soft brush attachment, and plump and turn the seat and back cushions every few days so they wear evenly.

Keep your sofa out of strong direct sunlight, which can fade fabric and dry out leather, and at least a foot away from radiators and heaters.

For spills on fabric, blot straight away with a clean white cloth. Do not rub, because rubbing pushes the liquid deeper into the weave. Check the care code on the label under the seat cushions before using any cleaning product. Code W fabrics can be cleaned with a little water-based upholstery cleaner, while code S fabrics need a solvent-based cleaner or a professional cleaning service.

Leather sofas need conditioning about every six months. Use a conditioner made for pigmented leather and test it on a hidden area first. Removable cushion covers should not be machine washed, because they can shrink and will no longer fit the cushions.

gold_spans.quote: Tindlecroft covers your sofa frame against breaks and joint failures for ten years from the delivery date, provided the sofa is registered on the Tindlecroft website within 30 days of delivery.

gold.dropped_qualifier: provided the sofa is registered on the Tindlecroft website within 30 days of delivery

construction.note: Deleted only the registration condition (and its comma); S1 gives the ten-year frame cover only to sofas registered within 30 days and no passage says what cover an unregistered sofa has, so the unconditional claim is unsupported, not contradicted.

question: Does Merrowind Health cover acupuncture?
answer: Acupuncture is covered for up to 20 visits per plan year.

sources.title: Merrowind Health - Compare our 2027 plans
sources.text:
Merrowind offers three individual and family plans for 2027: Essential, Plus and Premier. All three plans use the same network of doctors and hospitals, and all three cover preventive care, such as annual checkups, vaccines and screenings, at no cost when you see an in-network provider.

For an individual, the monthly premium is $318 on Essential, $402 on Plus and $541 on Premier. The annual deductible is $4,200 on Essential, $2,100 on Plus and $800 on Premier, and the out-of-pocket maximum is $8,700, $6,900 and $4,500 respectively. Family deductibles and out-of-pocket maximums are twice the individual amounts.

If you expect to use a lot of care during the year, a plan with a higher premium and a lower deductible may cost less overall. If you rarely see a doctor, Essential keeps your monthly cost lowest.

Open enrollment for 2027 coverage runs from 1 November 2026 to 15 January 2027, and you can switch between plans during that time. Our plan advisors can talk you through the options by phone or video chat.

sources.title: Merrowind Health - Premier plan: complementary care
sources.text:
Members on the Merrowind Premier plan have a set of complementary care benefits alongside their medical coverage. These benefits are aimed at long-term pain, stress and recovery after an injury. To use them, book an appointment with the practitioner and show your Merrowind member ID card at the visit.

Acupuncture
On the Merrowind Premier plan, acupuncture is covered for up to 20 visits per plan year. Visits count toward the limit whether they are for a new problem or an ongoing one, and a first assessment appointment counts as one visit.

Massage therapy
Massage therapy is included when it is part of a treatment plan written by a physical therapist or chiropractor.

Tracking your visits
Your member account shows how many complementary care visits you have used so far this plan year. The plan year starts on 1 January, and visit counts go back to zero at the start of each plan year.

gold_spans.quote: On the Merrowind Premier plan, acupuncture is covered for up to 20 visits per plan year.

gold.dropped_qualifier: On the Merrowind Premier plan

construction.note: Deleted only the plan scope and recapitalised; S2 states acupuncture cover only for Premier, S1 shows Essential and Plus exist, and no passage says anything about acupuncture on those plans, so the unscoped claim is unsupported, not contradicted.

question: What warranty does Brackenfold Cycles give on bike frames?
answer: Brackenfold covers frame defects with a lifetime warranty.

sources.title: Brackenfold Cycles - Choosing your frame size
sources.text:
Getting the right frame size matters more than almost any other choice you make when buying a bike. A frame that is too big or too small is uncomfortable on long rides and harder to control on descents.

Whether you choose a Harlow bike or one from the other makers we stock, every product page has a size chart that lists a recommended rider height range for each frame size. If your height falls between two sizes, the smaller size usually gives a more upright, relaxed position, and the larger size a longer, stretched-out one.

For a closer fit, measure your inside leg: stand barefoot with your back against a wall, put a hardback book between your legs and pull it up firmly, then measure from the top of the book to the floor. Enter that measurement, with your height, into the fit calculator on the product page.

If you are still unsure, book a free 20-minute video fit call with our workshop team. They can talk you through the geometry charts and help you compare models.

sources.title: Brackenfold Cycles - Harlow frame warranty
sources.text:
Harlow is Brackenfold's own range of road, gravel and commuter bicycles. Every Harlow frame is designed by our team, made by a single partner factory, and checked again in our workshop before the bike is built up.

Warranty cover
On Harlow-brand bicycles, Brackenfold covers frame defects with a lifetime warranty. A frame defect is a crack, break or failed weld that comes from the way the frame was made, rather than from a crash, an impact or a modification. If we confirm a defect, we will send you a replacement frame of the same model, or the closest current model if yours is no longer made.

Making a claim
Email our workshop team with your order number, the serial number from the underside of the frame, and clear photos of the damage. We may ask you to take the bike to a local bike shop for an inspection, and we will pay the inspection fee if the shop confirms a frame defect.

Paint and finish
Chips and scratches in the paint are not frame defects. Touch-up paint in every Harlow colour can be ordered from the Spares section of our website.

sources.title: Brackenfold Cycles - How your bike is delivered
sources.text:
Every complete bike we send out is built up, adjusted and test-ridden in our workshop before it is boxed. That means it arrives almost ready to ride: you only need to straighten and tighten the handlebar, fit the pedals and pump up the tyres.

Each box includes a multi-tool, a pedal spanner and a printed setup guide, and there is a step-by-step video for every model on our website. Most people are ready to ride within 20 minutes of opening the box.

Bikes travel with a specialist courier in a double-walled box, with foam protection on the frame and fork. You will get a two-hour delivery window by text on the morning of delivery, and someone needs to be at home to sign for the bike.

Check the box for damage before you sign. If the box is badly damaged, note that on the courier's device and send us photos within 48 hours so we can sort it out with the courier.

gold.target_claim: Brackenfold covers frame defects with a lifetime warranty.

gold_spans.quote: On Harlow-brand bicycles, Brackenfold covers frame defects with a lifetime warranty.

gold.dropped_qualifier: On Harlow-brand bicycles

construction.note: Deleted only the product-line scope; S2 gives the lifetime frame warranty only for Harlow bikes, S1 shows Brackenfold also sells other makers' bikes, and no passage states a warranty for those, so the unscoped claim is unsupported, not contradicted.

question: How much is the copay for a video visit with Wyncourt Virtual Care?
answer: Video visits with Wyncourt Virtual Care have a $0 copay.

sources.title: Wyncourt Health Alliance - Urgent care or the emergency room?
sources.text:
When you need care quickly, choosing the right place can save you time and money. Urgent care centers treat problems that need attention today but are not life-threatening, such as sprains, minor cuts that need stitches, ear infections and high fevers. Most Wyncourt network urgent care centers are open from 8 am to 8 pm every day, and you do not need an appointment.

On Wyncourt plans, an in-network urgent care visit has a $50 copay. An emergency room visit has a $350 copay, which is waived if you are admitted to the hospital from the emergency room.

Go to the emergency room or call 911 for chest pain, trouble breathing, signs of a stroke, severe bleeding or a serious head injury. Emergency care is covered at the in-network level at any hospital, including hospitals outside the Wyncourt network.

If you are not sure where to go, call the 24-hour nurse line on the back of your member ID card. A registered nurse can talk through your symptoms and suggest the right setting.

sources.title: Wyncourt Health Alliance - Wyncourt Virtual Care
sources.text:
Wyncourt Virtual Care lets you see a board-certified clinician by video from your phone, tablet or computer, usually within 30 minutes of requesting a visit. Clinicians can diagnose and treat common conditions such as colds, sinus infections, rashes and urinary tract infections, and they can send prescriptions to the pharmacy you choose.

Video visit copay
From 1 January 2027 through 30 June 2027, video visits with Wyncourt Virtual Care have a $0 copay. You do not need a code or any sign-up to get this, and it is applied automatically when the visit starts.

When to choose in-person care
The clinician will tell you if your symptoms need a physical exam, lab tests or imaging, and can help you find an in-network clinic. If you have chest pain, trouble breathing or signs of a stroke, call 911 instead of starting a video visit.

Getting set up
Download the Wyncourt app, sign in with your member account details and add your preferred pharmacy. Setting up before you feel unwell means your first visit can start more quickly. Visits are available 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

question: Does Brisklane Messenger keep a copy of my messages on its servers?
answer: A copy of your message history is stored in encrypted form on Brisklane servers.

sources.title: Brisklane Messenger - Blocking and reporting contacts
sources.text:
If someone is bothering you on Brisklane Messenger, you can block them. Open your chat with that person, tap their name at the top of the screen and choose Block. You can also block a number that is not saved in your contacts from the same menu.

Once you block a contact, they can no longer call you or send you messages, and they will not see your profile photo, status or last-seen time. Blocking does not remove the person from your phone's address book, and they are not told that you have blocked them. If you are both members of the same group chat, you will still see each other's messages in that group.

To see everyone you have blocked, go to Settings > Privacy > Blocked contacts. Tap a name and choose Unblock to let that person contact you again. You will not receive any calls or messages they attempted while they were blocked.

Reporting
If a contact is sending spam or abusive content, choose Report instead of, or as well as, Block. A report sends the contact's phone number and the reason you selected to the Brisklane safety team, who may restrict or close accounts that break our community rules. You can report a group in the same way from the group's info screen.

sources.title: Brisklane Messenger - Chat Backup and your privacy
sources.text:
Chat Backup helps you keep your conversations when you move to a new phone or reinstall Brisklane Messenger. You can turn it on or off at any time under Settings > Chats > Chat Backup.

If you turn on Chat Backup, a copy of your message history is stored in encrypted form on Brisklane servers. The backup is encrypted with a key created from a backup password that you choose during setup. Brisklane does not keep a copy of that password, so if you forget it we cannot open the backup for you, and you will need to create a new one.

What a backup contains
A backup includes the text of your messages, the names of the group chats you belong to, and the date and time each message was sent or received. Photos, videos and voice notes are added to the backup if you tick Include media during setup.

When backups run
A new backup is made once a day while your phone is charging and connected to Wi-Fi. You can also start a backup at any time by tapping Back up now.

Restoring on a new phone
When you install Brisklane Messenger on a new phone and verify your number, you will be asked whether you want to restore a backup. You will need your backup password. Restoring brings back your chats as they were at the time of the last backup.

Deleting a backup
To delete your backup, open Chat Backup and choose Delete backup. Deleting a backup does not delete any messages that are still on your phone.

sources.title: Brisklane Messenger - Changing your phone number
sources.text:
Your Brisklane Messenger account is linked to your phone number. If you get a new number, use Change number rather than creating a new account, so that you keep your profile, settings and group memberships.

Before you start, make sure the SIM card for your new number is in your phone and can receive text messages or calls. Then go to Settings > Account > Change number, enter your old number and your new number, and tap Next. We will send a six-digit verification code to the new number.

Once the change is complete, your profile photo, name, about text and privacy settings move to the new number. You stay a member of every group you belonged to, and the other members see a short notice in each group saying that your number has changed.

You can also choose whether to tell your individual contacts about the change. Pick All contacts, Contacts I have chats with, or Custom to choose people one by one. Contacts you do not notify will not see your new number until they add it themselves, so we recommend telling anyone you talk to often.

If you no longer have access to your old number, you can still move your account by contacting support from the Help screen in the app, but we may ask you to confirm your identity first.

gold.target_claim: Brisklane stores an encrypted copy of a user's message history on its servers, with no Chat Backup condition.

gold_spans.quote: If you turn on Chat Backup, a copy of your message history is stored in encrypted form on Brisklane servers.

gold.dropped_qualifier: If you turn on Chat Backup

Blocking does not remove the person from your phone's address book, and they are not told that you have blocked them. If you are both members of the same group chat, you will still see each other's messages in that group.

To see everyone you have blocked, go to Settings > Privacy > Blocked contacts. Tap a name and choose Unblock to let that person contact you again. You will not receive any calls or messages they attempted while they were blocked.

Reporting
If a contact is sending spam or abusive content, choose Report instead of, or as well as, Block. A report sends the contact's phone number and the reason you selected to the Brisklane safety team, who may restrict or close accounts that break our community rules. You can report a group in the same way from the group's info screen.

sources.title: Brisklane Messenger - Chat Backup and your privacy
sources.text:
Chat Backup helps you keep your conversations when you move to a new phone or reinstall Brisklane Messenger. You can turn it on or off at any time under Settings > Chats > Chat Backup.

If you turn on Chat Backup, a copy of your message history is stored in encrypted form on Brisklane servers. The backup is encrypted with a key created from a backup password that you choose during setup. Brisklane does not keep a copy of that password, so if you forget it we cannot open the backup for you, and you will need to create a new one.

What a backup contains
A backup includes the text of your messages, the names of the group chats you belong to, and the date and time each message was sent or received. Photos, videos and voice notes are added to the backup if you tick Include media during setup.

When backups run
A new backup is made once a day while your phone is charging and connected to Wi-Fi. You can also start a backup at any time by tapping Back up now.

Restoring on a new phone
When you install Brisklane Messenger on a new phone and verify your number, you will be asked whether you want to restore a backup. You will need your backup password. Restoring brings back your chats as they were at the time of the last backup.

Deleting a backup
To delete your backup, open Chat Backup and choose Delete backup. Deleting a backup does not delete any messages that are still on your phone.

sources.title: Brisklane Messenger - Changing your phone number
sources.text:
Your Brisklane Messenger account is linked to your phone number. If you get a new number, use Change number rather than creating a new account, so that you keep your profile, settings and group memberships.

Before you start, make sure the SIM card for your new number is in your phone and can receive text messages or calls. Then go to Settings > Account > Change number, enter your old number and your new number, and tap Next. We will send a six-digit verification code to the new number.

Once the change is complete, your profile photo, name, about text and privacy settings move to the new number. You stay a member of every group you belonged to, and the other members see a short notice in each group saying that your number has changed.

You can also choose whether to tell your individual contacts about the change. Pick All contacts, Contacts I have chats with, or Custom to choose people one by one. Contacts you do not notify will not see your new number until they add it themselves, so we recommend telling anyone you talk to often.

If you no longer have access to your old number, you can still move your account by contacting support from the Help screen in the app, but we may ask you to confirm your identity first.

question: Does Fallowmere Bank charge a fee if a card payment takes my balance below zero?
answer: Card payments that take your balance up to $100 below zero are approved without a fee.

sources.title: Fallowmere Bank - Cushion for your Everyday account
sources.text:
Cushion is a feature of the Fallowmere Everyday account that can help when your balance is running low. There is nothing to apply for, and Cushion does not involve a credit check or affect your credit score.

If your account has received at least two direct deposits in the past 35 days, card payments that take your balance up to $100 below zero are approved without a fee. A direct deposit is an electronic payment of wages, a pension or government benefits made into your account by an employer or other payer. Transfers between your own accounts do not count as direct deposits.

This applies to debit card purchases made in shops, online and over the phone, including subscriptions that renew automatically on your card.

Paying it back
When your balance is below zero, the amount you owe is shown in orange at the top of the Fallowmere app. The next money paid into your account is used to bring your balance back to zero before anything else. We ask you to bring your balance back to at least zero within 30 days.

Keeping track
The Cushion screen in the app shows how far below zero your balance is at any time. We also send a notification each time a card payment takes your balance below zero, so that it never comes as a surprise.

sources.title: Fallowmere Bank - Early Pay
sources.text:
Early Pay can make your wages available up to two days before your payday. It is included with every Fallowmere Everyday account at no extra cost, and it switches on automatically the first time your employer pays you by direct deposit.

How it works
Employers usually send details of a payroll payment to the bank a day or two before the money is due to arrive. When we receive those details for a payment to your account, we make the money available to you straight away instead of waiting for the payment date. You receive the same amount you would otherwise receive on payday.

How early your money arrives depends on when your employer sends the payment details, so it can vary from one payday to the next. If your employer sends the details late, your money will arrive on your usual payday.

Which payments are included
Early Pay works for wages, pensions and government benefits paid by direct deposit. It does not apply to transfers from friends or family, or to payments from your accounts at other banks.

Turning Early Pay off
Some people prefer to receive their wages on the same day each month. You can turn Early Pay off under Account > Early Pay and turn it back on whenever you like.

sources.title: Fallowmere Bank - Lost or stolen cards
sources.text:
If you cannot find your Fallowmere debit card, freeze it straight away in the app by tapping Card > Freeze. A frozen card cannot be used for new purchases or cash withdrawals, but regular payments you have already set up, such as subscriptions, will continue. If you find the card again, tap Unfreeze and it will work as normal.

If you think your card has been stolen, or someone has used it without your permission, report it in the app under Card > Report stolen. This cancels the card permanently, and we will post a replacement to your home address. Replacement cards usually arrive within five to seven business days and have a new card number.

You can add your new card to your phone's wallet as soon as you order the replacement, so you can keep paying while you wait for the plastic card to arrive.

Unrecognised payments
If you see a payment you do not recognise, tap it in your transaction list and choose Report a problem. Our team will contact you within one business day. You will not be held responsible for payments you did not make or authorise, as long as you report them promptly.

gold_spans.quote: If your account has received at least two direct deposits in the past 35 days, card payments that take your balance up to $100 below zero are approved without a fee.

gold.dropped_qualifier: If your account has received at least two direct deposits in the past 35 days

question: Where does Varrowby store my profile data?
answer: Varrowby stores profile data in data centres located in Frankfurt and Dublin.

sources.title: Varrowby Privacy Notice - Cookies and similar technologies
sources.text:
Varrowby uses cookies and similar technologies on our website and in our apps. A cookie is a small text file that a website saves on your device so that it can recognise your device on a later visit.

Essential cookies
Some cookies are needed for Varrowby to work. They keep you signed in, remember the club events you have saved, and help protect your account against fraud. These cookies cannot be switched off, because the service would not work without them.

Preference cookies
Preference cookies remember choices you make, such as your language and whether you prefer the light or dark theme. If you switch them off, you will need to make these choices again each time you visit.

Analytics cookies
With your permission, we use analytics cookies to count visits and see which pages are used most, so that we can improve Varrowby. The information is grouped together and does not tell us who you are.

Managing your choices
When you first visit Varrowby, we ask which optional cookies you are happy for us to use. You can change your choices at any time from the Cookie settings link at the bottom of every page. Your choices apply to the device and browser you are using at the time.

sources.title: Varrowby Privacy Notice - Where your data is stored
sources.text:
This section of the Varrowby Privacy Notice explains where the information in your Varrowby account is kept and how we look after it.

Profile data is the information you add to your Varrowby profile: your display name, profile photo, short bio, the clubs you have joined and your notification preferences. Posts and messages you share in clubs are covered in the Club Content section of this notice.

For users in the European Economic Area, Varrowby stores profile data in data centres located in Frankfurt and Dublin. These data centres are run by our hosting partner under a written contract that requires the partner to handle the data only as we instruct and to keep it secure.

Backups
Copies of profile data are kept in encrypted backups so that we can restore the service if equipment fails. Backups are replaced on a rolling basis, and no backup is kept for longer than 35 days.

Who can access it
Access to profile data is limited to Varrowby staff who need it to run the service, such as our support and trust and safety teams. Each time a member of staff opens a profile record, the access is logged, and our data protection team reviews these logs every month.

Questions
If you have questions about where your data is stored, you can contact our data protection officer using the details in the Contact Us section of this notice.

sources.title: Varrowby - Who can see your profile
sources.text:
Your Varrowby profile helps other members of your clubs recognise you. You decide how much of it other people can see.

Profile visibility
Under Settings > Privacy > Profile visibility, choose one of three options. Everyone means anyone signed in to Varrowby can view your profile. Club members means only people who belong to at least one of the same clubs as you can view it. Only me hides your profile from everyone except you, although other members will still see your display name next to your posts.

Your display name and profile photo
Your display name and profile photo are always shown next to anything you post in a club, whatever your visibility setting. If you would rather not show a photo, you can remove it and a coloured initial will be shown instead.

Clubs you have joined
You can hide the list of clubs you belong to from your profile by turning off Show my clubs. Club organisers can still see that you are a member of their own club.

Search
Members can find your profile by searching for your display name unless you turn off Let others find me by name. Turning this off does not hide you from people who already follow you.

gold.target_claim: Varrowby stores all users' profile data in data centres in Frankfurt and Dublin, with no regional limit.

gold_spans.quote: For users in the European Economic Area, Varrowby stores profile data in data centres located in Frankfurt and Dublin.

gold.dropped_qualifier: For users in the European Economic Area

construction.note: Deleted only the EEA scope; S2 gives the Frankfurt and Dublin location for EEA users and no passage says where other users' data is stored, so the claim for all users is unsupported.

question: Can I bring my dog or cat in the cabin on Merrowind Air?
answer: On domestic flights, small dogs and cats can travel in the cabin in a soft-sided carrier that fits under the seat in front of you.

sources.title: Merrowind Air - Pets in the cabin
sources.text:
On domestic flights, small dogs and cats can travel in the cabin in a soft-sided carrier that fits under the seat in front of you. The carrier can be no larger than 45 x 30 x 25 cm, and your pet must stay inside it, with the carrier closed, for the whole flight, including take-off, landing and taxiing.

Adding your pet to a booking
Call our reservations team at least 48 hours before departure to add your pet to your booking. Pets cannot be added in the app or at the airport. The pet fee is $95 for each flight and is paid when your pet is added.

Each passenger can bring one pet carrier. The carrier counts as your personal item, but you can still bring one cabin bag for the overhead locker.

Before you fly
Your pet must be at least 10 weeks old and able to stand up and turn around inside the carrier. Make sure your pet has had a chance to eat, drink and go to the toilet before you leave for the airport. Please check in at the airport desk rather than online, so that our staff can check the carrier and attach a pet tag to it.

On board
You will be seated in a window seat, away from the exit rows. Your pet must not be taken out of the carrier during the flight and must not be given food on board, although small amounts of water are fine.

sources.title: Merrowind Air - Flying with infants
sources.text:
Children under two years old can travel on your lap rather than in their own seat. Each adult can hold one infant on their lap, and the infant must be added to the booking when you book or later in Manage Booking. Infants on your lap travel for 10% of the adult fare, plus taxes.

Infant seats
If you would like your child to have their own seat, you can book a child ticket for them and bring an approved car seat. The car seat must fit in a standard economy seat and carry a label showing it is approved for use in aircraft.

Bassinets
A limited number of bassinets are available on flights longer than four hours, for babies weighing up to 10 kg. Request one by calling our reservations team. Bassinets are given out in the order requests are received.

Strollers and car seats
You can check in one stroller and one car seat for each child at no charge, in addition to your normal baggage allowance. Folding strollers can be left at the aircraft door and returned to you when you get off.

Feeding
You are welcome to bring baby food, formula and milk through security in reasonable quantities for your journey.

sources.title: Merrowind Air - Check-in times
sources.text:
Online check-in for Merrowind Air flights opens 24 hours before departure. You can check in on our website or in the app and keep your boarding pass on your phone.

When check-in closes
For domestic flights, check-in closes 45 minutes before departure. For international flights, check-in closes 60 minutes before departure. These times apply whether you check in online or at the airport desk, and they also apply to bag drop.

Who needs to check in at the desk
You will need to check in at an airport desk if you are travelling with an infant on your lap who is not yet on your booking, or with sporting equipment that must be measured. Desks open three hours before departure.

At the gate
Boarding starts 40 minutes before departure. The gate closes 15 minutes before departure, and we cannot hold the flight for passengers who arrive after this.

Documents
For international flights, bring a passport that is valid for the whole of your trip. We may also need to see your visa or residence permit at check-in.

question: What is Quorvel's hourly sending limit for a new domain?
answer: A new sending domain on Quorvel has an hourly sending limit of 1,000 emails.

sources.title: Quorvel Mail API - Sending your first message
sources.text:
To send a message, make a POST request to the /v1/messages endpoint with your API key in the Authorization header as a bearer token. The request body is JSON and must include from, to, subject, and at least one of text or html.

The from address must use a domain you have added to your Quorvel account. You can send to up to 50 recipients in a single request by passing an array in the to field; each recipient receives a separate copy, and other recipients' addresses are not shown.

A successful request returns HTTP 202 with a message_id for each recipient. Keep these IDs if you want to match delivery, open and bounce events to the messages you sent; every webhook event includes the message_id it relates to.

If the request body is invalid, the API returns HTTP 422 with a list of the fields that failed validation. Authentication problems return HTTP 401. The official Quorvel client libraries for Node.js, Python, Ruby and Go wrap these responses in typed errors and retry network timeouts for you.

sources.title: Quorvel Mail API - Sending limits for new domains
sources.text:
Mailbox providers are cautious about mail from domains they have not seen before, so Quorvel paces the volume a new domain can send while it builds a reputation. A domain counts as new for its first 30 days after it is added to your Quorvel account.

A new sending domain on Quorvel has an hourly sending limit of 1,000 emails if its DKIM record has been verified. To verify DKIM, copy the two CNAME records shown on the Domains page into your DNS settings and choose Check records. Most DNS providers publish changes within an hour, although some take up to 48 hours.

Messages that would go over the hourly limit are not rejected. The API accepts them with status 202 and places them in a queue, and Quorvel releases them in the following hours in the order they were received. The Activity page shows how many messages are waiting.

To help a new domain warm up smoothly, start with your most engaged recipients, such as people who signed up or bought something recently, and keep complaint rates below 0.1%. Large campaigns to old or purchased lists in the first month are the most common reason a domain's reputation suffers.

sources.title: Quorvel Mail API - Suppression lists
sources.text:
Quorvel keeps a suppression list for each account so that you do not keep emailing addresses that cannot or should not receive your mail. An address is added automatically when a message to it hard bounces, when the recipient marks a message as spam, or when they use the unsubscribe link in a message sent through Quorvel.

When you send to a suppressed address, the API still returns HTTP 202, but the message is not delivered and a suppressed event is sent to your webhook instead. This keeps your sending code simple, because you do not need to check the list yourself before every send.

You can view, search and export the suppression list from the Suppressions page or through the /v1/suppressions endpoint. Addresses that were added because of a hard bounce can be removed if you are confident the problem has been fixed, for example after a typo in a customer record is corrected. Addresses added because of a spam complaint or an unsubscribe can only be removed by the recipient opting in again.

gold.target_claim: A new sending domain on Quorvel has an hourly sending limit of 1,000 emails.

gold_spans.quote: A new sending domain on Quorvel has an hourly sending limit of 1,000 emails if its DKIM record has been verified.

gold.dropped_qualifier: if its DKIM record has been verified

construction.note: Deleted only the condition 'if its DKIM record has been verified'; S2 gives the 1,000-per-hour limit only for DKIM-verified new domains and no passage gives a limit for unverified ones, so the unconditional limit is unsupported.

question: How much does the Inkravel Sign Team plan cost?
answer: The Inkravel Sign Team plan costs $6 per user per month.

sources.title: Inkravel Sign - Pricing and billing in India
sources.text:
This page covers prices, tax and payment for Inkravel Sign accounts whose billing address is in India.

For customers with a billing address in India, the Inkravel Sign Team plan costs $6 per user per month. Prices are set in US dollars, and your bank may show the charge in rupees after converting it at its own exchange rate. Goods and services tax (GST) at 18% is added to every charge. If your business is registered for GST, enter your GSTIN under Billing, then Company details, and it will appear on every invoice so that you can claim input tax credit. Invoices are issued by our Indian billing entity and can be downloaded as PDF files from the Billing page.

sources.title: Inkravel Sign - Signer authentication options
sources.text:
By default, a signer opens a document from the link in their invitation email. For documents that need stronger proof of identity, you can add an authentication step that the signer must complete before the document opens.

Three options are available. Access code: you choose a code and share it with the signer by another channel, such as a phone call. SMS code: Inkravel Sign texts a six-digit code to a mobile number you enter for the signer. Identity document check: the signer photographs a passport or driving licence and records a short selfie video, which is compared with the document photo.

You can set a different option for each signer on the same envelope. The audit trail records which method each signer used and the time they passed it.

Signers get three attempts at an access code or SMS code before the envelope is locked for that signer; the sender can unlock it from the envelope page. Identity document checks are charged per check and appear as a separate line on your usage statement.

sources.title: Inkravel Sign - Where your documents are stored
sources.text:
When you create an Inkravel Sign account, you choose where your signed documents and audit trails are stored. Three storage regions are available: the European Union (Frankfurt), India (Mumbai) and the United States (Virginia). The region is shown on the Security page of your account settings.

All copies of your documents, including backups, stay inside the chosen region. Signing pages are served from the location nearest to each signer for speed, but the document itself is fetched from your storage region and is not cached anywhere else.

The storage region does not have to match your billing address. A company billed in Germany can store its documents in the United States, for example, if that is where its own customers expect them to be.

Moving an existing account to a different region is possible on annual plans. Our support team schedules the move, which usually takes place over a weekend, and documents are read-only for up to six hours while the transfer completes. Templates, users and integrations move with the account, and links in previously sent emails keep working.

question: When will Ferncroft Forms stop selling the Classic plan?
answer: Ferncroft Forms stops selling the Classic plan to new customers on 15 July 2027.

sources.title: Retiring the Classic plan
sources.text:
Ferncroft Forms stops selling the Classic plan to new customers on 15 January 2027. Workspaces already on Classic are not moved automatically: existing Classic subscriptions keep renewing at their current price, with the same features and limits.

To help Classic subscribers move to the current plan line-up, Ferncroft Forms is offering a discount on the Pro plan. Between 15 January and 15 July 2027, Classic subscribers can switch to the Pro plan at a 30% discount for the first year. The discount applies to the Pro list price for twelve months from the date of the switch and then ends, so from the second year the workspace pays the standard Pro price. The offer ends on 15 July 2027, and switches made after that date are charged the standard Pro price from the start.

A workspace that switches to Pro cannot return to Classic later, because Classic will no longer be open for sign-up. Workspace owners can make the switch from Settings > Plan > Explore plans.

sources.title: Ferncroft Forms Pro plan
sources.text:
The Pro plan is Ferncroft Forms' main plan for teams that collect data at volume. It costs $24 per month on monthly billing or $240 per year on annual billing, and includes 5 team members, unlimited forms and 10,000 responses per month. Additional team members cost $6 per month each.

Pro adds features that are not available on the Starter plan: conditional logic with up to 50 rules per form, file upload fields with 10 GB of total file storage, custom thank-you pages and removal of Ferncroft branding. Payment fields on Pro connect to a card processor of your choice, and Ferncroft Forms charges no additional transaction fee.

The Business plan, at $59 per month, raises the response allowance to 50,000 per month, adds single sign-on and allows data residency in the EU or Australia. Both plans include a 14-day free trial for new workspaces, with no payment card required.

sources.title: What happens when you reach your response limit
sources.text:
Each Ferncroft Forms plan includes a monthly number of form responses, counted across every form in the workspace. The count resets on the first day of each billing period. Partial submissions that are saved but never sent are not counted.

When a workspace reaches 90% of its allowance, owners see a warning banner and receive an email. Once the allowance is used up, live forms show a message saying the form is temporarily closed, and new responses are not accepted until the next billing period starts or the workspace changes plan. Responses already collected stay available to view and export.

Pro and Business workspaces can turn on overage instead of closing forms. With overage on, forms keep accepting responses, and each extra block of 1,000 responses is charged at $8 on the next invoice. Overage can be capped at a monthly spending limit set by the owner.

gold.target_claim: Ferncroft Forms stops selling the Classic plan to new customers on 15 July 2027.

gold_spans.quote: Ferncroft Forms stops selling the Classic plan to new customers on 15 January 2027.

construction.note: The stop-selling event is attached to 15 July 2027, which S1 uses as the end of the Pro discount offer; S1 dates the stop-selling to 15 January 2027. Same sources as family s1-f6.

question: How long is the Murlow Notes Pro trial?
answer: The Murlow Notes Pro trial lasts 21 days.

sources.title: Getting started with Murlow Notes Pro
sources.text:
Murlow Notes Pro adds shared notebooks, version history and offline access on mobile to the free app. New users can try Pro before paying. The Pro trial lasts 14 days and starts as soon as you choose Start trial in the app; no payment card is needed to begin.

During the trial you have the full Pro feature set, including up to 20 GB of attachments and sharing with up to 10 collaborators per notebook. When the trial ends, the account returns to the free plan unless you have added a payment method and chosen a billing interval.

Notes and notebooks created during the trial are kept when the account returns to the free plan. Shared notebooks become read-only for collaborators, and attachments above the free plan's 1 GB limit can still be downloaded, but no new attachments can be added until space is freed.

sources.title: Murlow Notes pricing FAQ
sources.text:
How much does Murlow Notes Pro cost? Pro costs $5 per month, or $48 per year if you pay annually. Prices are shown in your local currency in the app store you use, and local taxes may apply.

Is there a free trial? Yes. The Pro trial lasts 21 days, and you can cancel at any point during the trial without being charged. Each account can use the trial once.

Can I share Pro with my family? A Family subscription covers up to 5 people for $9 per month. Each person keeps a separate account and their own private notebooks, and the subscription owner manages billing.

Do students get a discount? Students with a valid school email address can get Pro for $2.50 per month for up to four years. The student discount is checked again every 12 months.

question: What would a Halvanta Backup Team workspace with 10 devices pay per year on annual billing?
answer: A Halvanta Backup Team workspace with 10 devices pays $816 a year on annual billing.

sources.title: Version history and retention
sources.text:
Halvanta Backup keeps earlier versions of files so that accidental changes can be undone. On the Personal plan, file versions and deleted files are kept for 30 days. On the Team plan they are kept for 1 year, and on the Business plan an admin can set retention to any period between 1 and 7 years.

Retention is counted from the day a version is replaced or a file is deleted on the device, not from the day it was first backed up. Versions that are older than the retention period are removed during a nightly clean-up and no longer count toward storage.

Admins on Team and Business can place a device on hold when an employee leaves. A held device stops backing up, but its existing backups are kept until the hold is released, even if they are older than the retention period. Held devices are not billed as active devices.

sources.title: Halvanta Backup plans
sources.text:
Halvanta Backup has three plans. Personal costs $6 per month and protects one computer, with unlimited backup storage for files on that computer's internal drives. External drives can be added for $2 per drive per month.

The Team plan costs $8 per device per month, with a minimum of 3 devices. Each device includes 1 TB of backup storage, and storage is pooled across the workspace, so a device that uses less leaves room for one that uses more. Team workspaces get an admin console, device groups and email support. Annual billing for Team is also available at a discounted rate.

The Business plan is for organisations protecting 50 or more devices and is priced by quote. It adds single sign-on, legal hold, a dedicated support contact and a choice of data region at sign-up.

Prices exclude sales tax and VAT, which are added at checkout based on the billing address.

sources.title: Buying extra storage on the Team plan
sources.text:
When a Team workspace needs more space than its pooled allowance, an admin can buy storage add-ons instead of adding devices. On the Team plan, Halvanta Backup workspaces can add backup storage in 500 GB blocks for $12 per block per month. Blocks join the workspace's shared pool as soon as the purchase is confirmed and can be used by any device in the workspace.

Each Team plan workspace can hold a maximum of 20 add-on blocks at a time, which adds up to 10 TB of extra storage.

Blocks are bought and removed from Admin console > Billing > Storage. A block can only be removed if the workspace's stored data still fits within the remaining allowance after the removal. Removed blocks stop appearing on invoices from the next billing period. If stored data goes over the total allowance, new backups pause until space is freed or more storage is added; existing backups are not deleted.

gold.target_claim: A Halvanta Backup Team workspace with 10 devices pays $816 a year on annual billing.

gold_spans.quote: The Team plan costs $8 per device per month, with a minimum of 3 devices.
Annual billing for Team is also available at a discounted rate.

construction.note: $816 equals 10 devices x $8 x 12 months less 15%; S2 says annual billing is discounted but never gives the rate, so the total cannot be computed from the passages. Same sources as family s1-f5.

question: Can I get a refund if I cancel a Tessaline Cloud annual plan soon after buying it?
answer: Tessaline Cloud refunds the full amount paid for an annual plan that is cancelled within 45 days of the original purchase date, provided the workspace has used less than 50 GB of outbound data transfer during that period.

sources.title: Tessaline Cloud plans and pricing
sources.text:
Tessaline Cloud offers three self-serve plans for managed database hosting. The Starter plan costs $29 per month and includes one database cluster, 20 GB of storage and 50 GB of outbound data transfer each month. The Growth plan costs $119 per month and includes up to five clusters, 250 GB of storage and 1 TB of outbound transfer. The Scale plan costs $480 per month and includes up to twenty clusters, 2 TB of storage and 5 TB of outbound transfer.

Every plan can be billed monthly or annually. Annual billing is charged for twelve months at the price of ten, and the annual price is locked for the full term even if list prices change during that term.

Outbound transfer above a plan's monthly allowance is charged at $0.08 per GB and appears on the next invoice. Inbound transfer and transfer between clusters in the same region are not charged. Storage above the allowance is charged at $0.15 per GB per month, measured as the daily peak averaged over the billing period.

sources.title: Refunds for annual subscriptions
sources.text:
Tessaline Cloud charges annual subscriptions up front for the full twelve-month term. Tessaline Cloud refunds the full amount paid for an annual plan that is cancelled within 30 days of the original purchase date, provided the workspace has used less than 50 GB of outbound data transfer during that period. After the 30-day window, annual plans are not refundable, but the workspace keeps access to all paid features until the end of the term that has already been paid for.

Refunds go back to the original payment method. Card refunds typically appear on the cardholder's statement within 5 to 10 business days. Refunds for invoices paid by bank transfer are issued as a credit note first and then paid out within 15 business days. Taxes that were remitted to a tax authority on the customer's behalf are not refunded unless the authority returns them to Tessaline Cloud.

Only the workspace owner can request a refund, using Settings > Billing > Request a refund. Requests sent by other workspace members, or emailed to a support agent, cannot be processed.

sources.title: Changing your Tessaline Cloud plan
sources.text:
You can move between the Starter, Growth and Scale plans at any time from Settings > Billing > Change plan. Upgrades take effect immediately. When you upgrade partway through a billing period, Tessaline Cloud charges the difference between the two plans for the days remaining in that period, and the next full invoice is issued at the new plan's price.

Downgrades are scheduled for the start of the next billing period so that clusters are not interrupted mid-cycle. Before a downgrade can be scheduled, the workspace must already fit inside the lower plan's limits: extra clusters have to be deleted and stored data reduced below the lower plan's storage allowance. The billing page lists anything that is blocking the change.

Switching from monthly to annual billing starts a new twelve-month term on the day of the switch. Switching from annual to monthly billing is only possible at the end of the current annual term.

gold.target_claim: Tessaline Cloud refunds the full amount paid for an annual plan cancelled within 45 days of the original purchase date, subject to the 50 GB outbound transfer condition.

gold_spans.quote: Tessaline Cloud refunds the full amount paid for an annual plan that is cancelled within 30 days of the original purchase date, provided the workspace has used less than 50 GB of outbound data transfer during that period.
After the 30-day window, annual plans are not refundable

construction.note: Refund window changed from 30 to 45 days; S2 states the window is 30 days and that annual plans are not refundable after it, so days 31-45 are explicitly excluded.

sources.title: Refunds for annual subscriptions
sources.text:
Tessaline Cloud charges annual subscriptions up front for the full twelve-month term. Tessaline Cloud refunds the full amount paid for an annual plan that is cancelled within 30 days of the original purchase date, provided the workspace has used less than 50 GB of outbound data transfer during that period. After the 30-day window, annual plans are not refundable, but the workspace keeps access to all paid features until the end of the term that has already been paid for.

Refunds go back to the original payment method. Card refunds typically appear on the cardholder's statement within 5 to 10 business days. Refunds for invoices paid by bank transfer are issued as a credit note first and then paid out within 15 business days. Taxes that were remitted to a tax authority on the customer's behalf are not refunded unless the authority returns them to Tessaline Cloud.

Only the workspace owner can request a refund, using Settings > Billing > Request a refund. Requests sent by other workspace members, or emailed to a support agent, cannot be processed.

sources.title: Changing your Tessaline Cloud plan
sources.text:
You can move between the Starter, Growth and Scale plans at any time from Settings > Billing > Change plan. Upgrades take effect immediately. When you upgrade partway through a billing period, Tessaline Cloud charges the difference between the two plans for the days remaining in that period, and the next full invoice is issued at the new plan's price.

Downgrades are scheduled for the start of the next billing period so that clusters are not interrupted mid-cycle. Before a downgrade can be scheduled, the workspace must already fit inside the lower plan's limits: extra clusters have to be deleted and stored data reduced below the lower plan's storage allowance. The billing page lists anything that is blocking the change.

question: What will the Orvane Analytics Team plan cost after the price change?
answer: From 1 February 2026, the Team plan costs $22 per seat per month for workspaces with a billing address in the United States or Canada.

sources.title: Team plan price change
sources.text:
Orvane Analytics is changing the price of the Team plan for the first time since the plan launched. From 1 March 2026, the Team plan costs $22 per seat per month for workspaces with a billing address in the United States or Canada. Until that date, those workspaces continue to pay the current price of $18 per seat per month. Workspaces with a billing address in any other country are on regional pricing, which is being reviewed separately and is not covered by this notice.

The new price applies to every seat in the workspace, including seats that were added before the change. Features and event allowances on the Team plan are not changing as part of this update. Orvane Analytics emails the owners of affected workspaces at least 45 days before the new price takes effect, and the notice also appears as a banner on the Billing page.

Owners who decide not to continue can cancel from the Billing page before their next renewal date. Cancelling does not delete project data, which stays readable for 30 days after the subscription ends.

sources.title: Event allowances by plan
sources.text:
Every Orvane Analytics plan includes a monthly allowance of tracked events. The Free plan includes 50,000 events per month across up to three seats. The Team plan includes 2 million events per month, shared across all seats in the workspace. The Business plan includes 10 million events per month and adds data warehouse export.

The allowance resets on the first day of each calendar month, regardless of when the workspace was created. Unused events do not carry over. When a workspace reaches 80% of its allowance, owners and admins receive an email, and a second email is sent at 100%.

Events sent after the allowance is used up are still collected, but they are held in a queue and cannot be queried until the workspace upgrades or the next month begins. Queued events are kept for 14 days; anything older is discarded. Raw event data on all paid plans is retained for 25 months.

sources.title: Adding and removing seats
sources.text:
Owners and admins can add seats to an Orvane Analytics workspace at any time from Settings > Members. A seat is needed for every person who can sign in, including read-only viewers on the Team plan. Seats added partway through a billing period are charged immediately for the days left in that period, and the full seat price is included on the next invoice.

Removing a seat does not trigger a refund for the current period. Instead, the removed seat stops being billed from the next invoice onward. If a workspace removes seats and adds them back within the same billing period, the re-added seats are not charged twice.

Workspaces on the Business plan can buy seats in packs of ten at a lower per-seat rate. Pack pricing is agreed with the sales team and is shown on the order form rather than on the public pricing page. Guests invited to a single shared dashboard do not need a seat.
