question: What do workspaces get under the Pallister Docs autumn upgrade offer?
answer: Workspaces that upgrade to the annual Plus plan between 1 October and 30 November 2026 receive 3 additional months free.

sources.title: Switching between monthly and annual billing
sources.text:
Workspace owners can change the billing interval from Settings > Billing at any time. When a workspace moves from monthly to annual billing, Pallister Docs credits the unused part of the current month and applies that credit to the first annual invoice. The annual term starts on the day of the switch.

Moving from annual to monthly billing takes effect at the end of the current annual term. Until then, the workspace stays on annual billing and keeps its annual price. Pallister Docs sends a reminder email 30 days before an annual term renews, showing the editor count and price that will be charged.

The billing interval applies to the whole workspace; individual editors cannot be billed on a different interval. Invoices are issued in US dollars, euros or pounds sterling depending on the billing country, and the currency cannot be changed once the first invoice has been paid.

sources.title: Pallister Docs plans
sources.text:
Pallister Docs has three plans. The Free plan is for individuals and small groups: up to 3 editors, unlimited viewers, 1 GB of file storage per workspace and 30 days of page history.

The Plus plan costs $10 per editor per month on monthly billing or $96 per editor per year on annual billing. It includes unlimited editors, 100 GB of storage, 1 year of page history and guest access for up to 20 external collaborators.

The Business plan costs $20 per editor per month on monthly billing or $192 per editor per year on annual billing. It adds single sign-on, audit logs, unlimited page history, 1 TB of storage and admin controls for sharing outside the organisation.

Viewers, who can read and comment but not edit, are free on every plan. A workspace is billed for the highest number of editors it had at any point during the billing period.

sources.title: Autumn upgrade offer
sources.text:
From 1 October to 30 November 2026, Pallister Docs is adding free months to new annual subscriptions. The free months are added to the end of the workspace's first annual term, so the first renewal date moves later while the first annual charge stays the same.

Workspaces that upgrade to the annual Business plan between 1 October and 30 November 2026 receive 3 additional months free. Workspaces that upgrade to the annual Plus plan in the same period receive 1 additional month free. Monthly subscriptions started during the offer period do not qualify, and switching an existing annual subscription to a different annual plan does not count as an upgrade.

Free months earned under the offer stay with the workspace that earned them. They cannot be moved to another workspace, exchanged for a discount on a later renewal, or paid out as credit if the subscription is cancelled. If a workspace downgrades from Business to Plus during its first annual term, any free months it has not yet used are reduced from 3 to 1.

sources.text:

question: How many calls per day does the Brakewater Weather free tier allow?
answer: The Brakewater Weather free tier includes 2,500 calls per day.

sources.title: Brakewater Weather: forecast endpoints
sources.text:
The /forecast endpoint returns hourly data for the next 48 hours and daily summaries for up to 16 days, depending on your plan. Each hourly entry includes temperature, feels-like temperature, precipitation probability, wind speed and direction, and a weather code. Daily summaries add sunrise, sunset, and minimum and maximum temperature.

Locations can be given as latitude and longitude or as a Brakewater Geo place ID. Using a place ID costs no extra calls, because Brakewater resolves it internally. Units default to metric; pass units=imperial for Fahrenheit and miles per hour.

Forecasts are refreshed every hour for the first 48 hours and every 6 hours after that. Responses include a generated_at timestamp so you can tell how fresh the data is, and a Cache-Control header that matches the refresh interval.

sources.title: Brakewater free tier
sources.text:
Brakewater offers two hosted APIs under a single developer account: Brakewater Geo, for IP and address lookups, and Brakewater Weather, for current conditions and forecasts. Each API has its own free tier, and usage on one does not count toward the other.

The Brakewater Geo free tier includes 2,500 calls per day. The Brakewater Weather free tier includes 1,000 calls per day, and forecast calls beyond 7 days ahead are not available on it. Both daily counters reset at 00:00 UTC.

Free-tier keys are limited to 2 requests per second on either API. When a daily allowance is used up, further calls return HTTP 429 with the error code daily_quota_exceeded until the counter resets. Free-tier use is for development and non-commercial projects; production applications serving customers need a paid plan, which starts at 50,000 calls per day.

question: When does Ondrel Billing start retrying failed webhooks for up to 72 hours?
answer: From 1 June 2026, Ondrel Billing retries a failed webhook delivery for up to 72 hours if the endpoint has extended retries enabled.

sources.title: Ondrel Billing webhook event types
sources.text:
Subscribe each webhook endpoint only to the events your integration handles. You can change an endpoint's subscriptions at any time; the change applies to events created after you save it.

Invoices
- invoice.created - a draft invoice was generated for a subscription or a one-off charge.
- invoice.finalized - the invoice was locked and sent to the customer.
- invoice.paid - payment succeeded in full.
- invoice.payment_failed - a payment attempt was declined or returned an error.

Subscriptions
- subscription.created, subscription.updated and subscription.cancelled.
- subscription.trial_ending - sent 3 days before a trial converts to a paid plan.

Customers
- customer.created and customer.updated.
- customer.tax_id_verified - a tax identifier passed validation.

Each event payload contains an id, a type, a created_at timestamp and a data object holding the full resource as it was when the event occurred. Events are kept in the event log for 30 days, where you can inspect payloads and see the response your endpoint returned to every attempt.

sources.title: Ondrel Billing webhooks: delivery and retries
sources.text:
Ondrel Billing sends each webhook event to your endpoint as an HTTPS POST request with a JSON body. Respond with any 2xx status within 10 seconds to acknowledge the event; slower responses are recorded as timeouts and count as failed deliveries.

Extended retries. From 1 December 2026, Ondrel Billing retries a failed webhook delivery for up to 72 hours if the endpoint has extended retries enabled. Retries use exponential backoff, starting at 1 minute and capped at 6 hours between attempts. Turn on extended retries for each endpoint under Settings > Developers > Webhooks.

Duplicates and ordering. Every attempt for the same event carries the same value in the Ondrel-Event-Id header, so your handler can discard events it has already processed. Events are not guaranteed to arrive in the order they were created; compare the created_at field in the payload if ordering matters.

Disabled endpoints. If every delivery to an endpoint has failed for 5 consecutive days, the endpoint is disabled automatically and the account owner is notified by email. Fix the underlying problem, then re-enable the endpoint from the same settings page. Events that occurred while the endpoint was disabled are not redelivered automatically, but you can replay them from the event log.

sources.title: Receiving test webhooks with the Ondrel command-line tool
sources.text:
The Ondrel command-line tool lets you receive test-mode webhook events on your own machine without exposing a public URL. After signing in with ondrel login, run ondrel listen --forward-to localhost:4000/hooks and the tool relays every test-mode event from your account to that local address.

The terminal shows each event type as it arrives, along with the status code your local server returned. To generate an event on demand, run ondrel trigger followed by an event type, for example ondrel trigger invoice.paid. Triggered events use fixture data and do not create real customers or charges.

Events relayed this way carry livemode set to false, so you can guard against processing them in production code. The listen command relays only events created while it is running; it does not fetch older events from the event log. A listen session ends after 8 hours, after which you need to run the command again. Live-mode events are never relayed by the command-line tool.

gold.target_claim: From 1 June 2026, Ondrel Billing retries failed webhook deliveries for up to 72 hours on endpoints that have extended retries enabled.

gold_spans.quote: From 1 December 2026, Ondrel Billing retries a failed webhook delivery for up to 72 hours if the endpoint has extended retries enabled.

construction.note: Start date changed 1 December 2026 -> 1 June 2026; S2 states the December date.

sources.title: Ondrel Billing webhook event types
sources.text:
Subscribe each webhook endpoint only to the events your integration handles. You can change an endpoint's subscriptions at any time; the change applies to events created after you save it.

Invoices
- invoice.created - a draft invoice was generated for a subscription or a one-off charge.
- invoice.finalized - the invoice was locked and sent to the customer.
- invoice.paid - payment succeeded in full.
- invoice.payment_failed - a payment attempt was declined or returned an error.

Subscriptions
- subscription.created, subscription.updated and subscription.cancelled.
- subscription.trial_ending - sent 3 days before a trial converts to a paid plan.

Customers
- customer.created and customer.updated.
- customer.tax_id_verified - a tax identifier passed validation.

Each event payload contains an id, a type, a created_at timestamp and a data object holding the full resource as it was when the event occurred. Events are kept in the event log for 30 days, where you can inspect payloads and see the response your endpoint returned to every attempt.

sources.title: Ondrel Billing webhooks: delivery and retries
sources.text:
Ondrel Billing sends each webhook event to your endpoint as an HTTPS POST request with a JSON body. Respond with any 2xx status within 10 seconds to acknowledge the event; slower responses are recorded as timeouts and count as failed deliveries.

Extended retries. From 1 December 2026, Ondrel Billing retries a failed webhook delivery for up to 72 hours if the endpoint has extended retries enabled. Retries use exponential backoff, starting at 1 minute and capped at 6 hours between attempts. Turn on extended retries for each endpoint under Settings > Developers > Webhooks.

Duplicates and ordering. Every attempt for the same event carries the same value in the Ondrel-Event-Id header, so your handler can discard events it has already processed. Events are not guaranteed to arrive in the order they were created; compare the created_at field in the payload if ordering matters.

Disabled endpoints. If every delivery to an endpoint has failed for 5 consecutive days, the endpoint is disabled automatically and the account owner is notified by email. Fix the underlying problem, then re-enable the endpoint from the same settings page. Events that occurred while the endpoint was disabled are not redelivered automatically, but you can replay them from the event log.

sources.text:

The terminal shows each event type as it arrives, along with the status code your local server returned. To generate an event on demand, run ondrel trigger followed by an event type, for example ondrel trigger invoice.paid. Triggered events use fixture data and do not create real customers or charges.

Events relayed this way carry livemode set to false, so you can guard against processing them in production code. The listen command relays only events created while it is running; it does not fetch older events from the event log. A listen session ends after 8 hours, after which you need to run the command again. Live-mode events are never relayed by the command-line tool.

question: Can I still get security fixes for a Marrowgate Python library version after it reaches end-of-life?
answer: Customers with an Enterprise support contract can request security backports for an end-of-life version of the Python library for a further 12 months after its end-of-life date.

sources.title: Installing the Marrowgate Node.js library
sources.text:
Install the Node.js library from the public package registry with your usual package manager. The current major version, 5.x, requires Node.js 20 or later and ships both ES module and CommonJS builds, so it works with import and require alike.

Create a client with your secret key and, optionally, a request timeout in milliseconds. The default timeout is 30 seconds. Failed requests that are safe to repeat are retried twice with a short randomised delay; set maxRetries to 0 to turn this off.

The library includes type definitions generated from the API specification, so editors can autocomplete every endpoint and field. Logging is off by default; pass a logger object with debug, info and error methods to see each request and response.

If your project still runs on Node.js 18, stay on the 4.x line until you can upgrade the runtime. Version 4.x is in its maintenance period and receives security fixes only.

sources.title: Marrowgate REST API versioning
sources.text:
The Marrowgate REST API is versioned separately from the client libraries. Each API version is named after the date it was released, such as 2026-03-01, and you select one by sending the Marrowgate-Version header. If you omit the header, the request is served by the version that was current when your account was created.

A dated API version is supported for at least 24 months after a newer version replaces it. During that time it continues to receive bug fixes and security fixes, but new endpoints and fields are added only to the newest version. Before a version is retired, Marrowgate emails every account that has called it in the previous 30 days.

The client libraries pin an API version when they are released. Upgrading a library to a new major version may therefore move your integration to a newer API version at the same time; the library changelog states which API version each release targets. You can override the pinned version in any library by setting the api_version option when you create the client.

sources.title: Marrowgate client library support policy
sources.text:
Marrowgate publishes official client libraries for Python, Java, Node.js and Go. Every library follows semantic versioning, and new features are added only to the latest major version.

When a new major version of a library is released, the previous major version enters a maintenance period during which it receives security fixes only. Maintenance lasts 18 months for every library. When maintenance ends, the version reaches end-of-life: it is removed from the quick-start guides, and support engineers will ask you to upgrade before investigating any issue that involves it.

Customers with an Enterprise support contract can request security backports for an end-of-life version of the Java library for a further 12 months after its end-of-life date. The same option is available for the Python library for a further 9 months; it is not offered for the Node.js or Go libraries. Backport requests are raised through the Enterprise support portal and are fulfilled within 10 business days of the fix being released in the current major version.

End-of-life dates for each version are announced in the library's release notes on the day the next major version ships.

sources.text:

question: How much is the Wardline Pro Monitoring price going up?
answer: The new Wardline Pro Monitoring price is a 10 percent increase on the current monthly price.

sources.title: How long camera clips are kept
sources.text:
Clips from Wardline cameras are saved to the cloud when motion is detected or an alarm goes off. How long they are kept depends on your plan.

Wardline Essentials keeps clips for 7 days. Wardline Plus keeps clips for 30 days, and Wardline Pro Monitoring keeps them for 60 days. Clips recorded during an alarm are kept for 90 days on every plan, so that you have time to share them with your insurer or the police.

When you change plan, the new retention period applies to clips recorded after the change. Clips you already have keep the retention period they were saved with.

To keep a clip for longer, open it in the History tab and tap Download. Downloaded clips are saved to your phone and are not deleted when the cloud copy expires. Deleting a clip in the app removes the cloud copy only; anything you have downloaded stays on your device.

sources.title: Wardline plan prices from 1 January 2027
sources.text:
From 1 January 2027, prices for some Wardline plans are changing. We will write to every affected customer at least 30 days before their first bill at the new price.

New monthly prices:
Wardline Essentials: no change.
Wardline Plus: 12.00 per month.
Wardline Pro Monitoring: 27.50 per month.

Prices include sales tax where it applies. If you pay yearly, the new price applies from your first renewal date after 1 January 2027, not from 1 January itself.

Why prices are changing: professional monitoring now includes video verification, where a monitoring agent reviews camera clips before contacting emergency services, and we have added 24-hour phone support on every plan.

You can see the price you pay today under Settings > Plan in the Ondrel app. If you would like to move to a different plan before the change, you can do so at any time from the same screen, with no fee.

gold.target_claim: The new Wardline Pro Monitoring price of 27.50 per month is 10 percent higher than the current price.

gold_spans.quote: Wardline Pro Monitoring: 27.50 per month.

construction.note: The percentage needs the current Pro Monitoring price, which no passage gives; S2 states only the new price and points to Settings > Plan for the current one.

answer: Wardline Plus keeps camera clips for 60 days.

sources.title: Changes to alarm history in the Ondrel app
sources.text:
We are moving alarm history to a new storage system so that the History tab loads faster and can be searched.

All alarm events recorded between 1 January 2023 and 31 May 2024 will be permanently deleted on 1 December 2026. Once they are deleted, Ondrel support cannot recover them.

If you want to keep a copy of these events, download them before the deletion date. In the app, go to Settings > Account > Download my data and choose Alarm history. The file arrives by email as a CSV within 24 hours. Each download covers up to 12 months of events, so you may need to request more than one.

This change affects alarm events only: arming and disarming, sensor triggers, panic button presses and siren activations. Camera clips are stored separately and follow the retention period of your plan.

Only the account owner can request a download. Shared users can still view alarm history in the app but cannot export it.

sources.title: Arming your system on a schedule
sources.text:
An arming schedule sets your Wardline system to Home or Away automatically at the times you choose, so you do not have to remember to arm it every night.

To create one, go to Settings > Security > Arming schedule and tap Add. Choose the mode, the time and the days of the week. You can add up to 6 schedules per system. Schedules follow the time zone set for your home, not the time zone of your phone.

Five minutes before a scheduled arming, everyone on the account who has notifications turned on receives a reminder. If a door or window is open at that time, the system arms anyway and leaves that sensor out until it is closed, and the app tells you which sensor was skipped.

Schedules can only arm the system. Disarming always needs a code, the app or a key fob, so a schedule will never disarm Wardline for you.

question: I live in France. Can I get a free courier pickup to repair my Glide?
answer: Owners in France whose Glide is under warranty can request a free courier pickup for repairs.

sources.title: Getting your Glide vacuum repaired
sources.text:
If your Glide vacuum has a fault that the troubleshooting steps in the app do not fix, contact Brindlecove support from the app under Help > Contact us. Have the serial number ready; you can find it under the dustbin or in the app under Vacuum > Settings > About.

Glide vacuums come with a two-year warranty from the date of purchase. Owners in Germany and Austria whose Glide is under warranty can request a free courier pickup for repairs. The courier brings a box and packing materials, so you do not need to keep the original packaging.

Repairs usually take 7 to 10 working days from when we receive the vacuum. We return it with the same settings and maps, unless the main board had to be replaced, in which case you will need to map your home again.

Batteries, brushes and filters are wear parts and are covered by the warranty for the first six months only. You can buy replacements in the app under Shop.

sources.title: Obstacle photos on the Glide R6
sources.text:
The Glide R6 has a front camera that recognises obstacles such as cables, socks and pet waste, and steers around them. When it avoids something, it can take a photo so you can see what was in the way and tidy it up.

Obstacle photos stay off until you turn them on under Vacuum > Settings > Obstacle photos. Photos are stored on the vacuum itself and are deleted automatically after 7 days. They appear in the app only while your phone is on the same Wi-Fi network as the vacuum, and they are never uploaded to Brindlecove servers.

You can delete all photos at once from the same settings screen. Turning the feature off also deletes any photos that are still stored.

The camera keeps working to avoid obstacles whether or not photos are turned on. It does not record video and has no microphone. A small white light next to the camera comes on while a photo is being taken.

gold.target_claim: Glide owners in France with a vacuum under warranty can request a free courier pickup for repairs.

gold_spans.quote: Owners in Germany and Austria whose Glide is under warranty can request a free courier pickup for repairs.

construction.note: S1 offers the free courier pickup to owners in Germany and Austria only; France is not mentioned or explicitly excluded anywhere, so the claim is unsupported rather than contradicted.

question: Do I have to turn on two-step verification for my Corvane account?
answer: Starting 2 May 2026, the Corvane app requires two-step verification for account owners who have invited shared users.

sources.title: Adding and removing shared users
sources.text:
You can share your Vista Doorbell with the people you live with so they can see who is at the door. Go to Account > Household, tap Invite, and enter the person's email address. They receive an invitation that stays valid for 7 days; if it expires, send a new one from the same screen.

Each account can have up to 8 shared users. Shared users can watch live video, view recorded clips, talk through the doorbell, and receive motion and ring alerts. They cannot change device settings, delete clips, manage your subscription, or invite other people.

To remove someone, open Account > Household, tap their name, and choose Remove. They lose access straight away. Any clips they downloaded to their own phone before you removed them stay on their phone.

If a shared user says they cannot see your doorbell, ask them to check that they accepted the invitation using the same email address you entered. Invitations cannot be moved from one email address to another.

sources.title: Resetting your Corvane password
sources.text:
If you have forgotten your password, tap Forgot password on the sign-in screen of the Corvane app and enter the email address on your account. We send you a reset link that works once and expires after 60 minutes.

Your new password must be at least 10 characters long and cannot match any of your last five passwords. After you change it, every phone and browser signed in to your account is signed out, including the Corvane app on your own phone, so you will need to sign in again.

Changing your password does not affect your shared users. They keep their access and continue to sign in with their own details.

If the reset email does not arrive within a few minutes, check your spam or junk folder, and make sure you entered the address you used when you created the account. For security reasons, Corvane support cannot set a password for you or tell you your password over the phone.

sources.title: Two-step verification for your Corvane account
sources.text:
Two-step verification adds a second check when someone signs in to your Corvane account. After entering your password, you confirm the sign-in with a six-digit code, either sent to you by text message or generated in an authenticator app.

Starting 2 March 2026, the Corvane app requires two-step verification for account owners who have invited shared users. Shared users are people you have added under Account > Household so that they can watch live video from your Vista Doorbell and receive its alerts. If this applies to you and you have not set up two-step verification by that date, the app asks you to set it up the next time you sign in, and live video stays locked until you finish.

To set it up at any time, go to Account > Security > Two-step verification and follow the prompts.

When you finish setup, the app shows ten single-use backup codes. Keep them somewhere safe and away from your phone: if you lose access to your phone, a backup code lets you sign in once. You can generate a new set at any time from the same screen, and doing so cancels any codes you have not used.

Shared users sign in with their own Corvane accounts. Their security settings are separate from yours, and turning on two-step verification for your account does not change how they sign in.

gold.target_claim: From 2 May 2026 the Corvane app requires two-step verification for account owners who have invited shared users.

gold_spans.quote: Starting 2 March 2026, the Corvane app requires two-step verification for account owners who have invited shared users.

construction.note: Start date changed from 2 March 2026 to 2 May 2026; S3 states the requirement starts on 2 March 2026.

If you have forgotten your password, tap Forgot password on the sign-in screen of the Corvane app and enter the email address on your account. We send you a reset link that works once and expires after 60 minutes.

Your new password must be at least 10 characters long and cannot match any of your last five passwords. After you change it, every phone and browser signed in to your account is signed out, including the Corvane app on your own phone, so you will need to sign in again.

Changing your password does not affect your shared users. They keep their access and continue to sign in with their own details.

If the reset email does not arrive within a few minutes, check your spam or junk folder, and make sure you entered the address you used when you created the account. For security reasons, Corvane support cannot set a password for you or tell you your password over the phone.

sources.title: Two-step verification for your Corvane account
sources.text:
Two-step verification adds a second check when someone signs in to your Corvane account. After entering your password, you confirm the sign-in with a six-digit code, either sent to you by text message or generated in an authenticator app.

Starting 2 March 2026, the Corvane app requires two-step verification for account owners who have invited shared users. Shared users are people you have added under Account > Household so that they can watch live video from your Vista Doorbell and receive its alerts. If this applies to you and you have not set up two-step verification by that date, the app asks you to set it up the next time you sign in, and live video stays locked until you finish.

To set it up at any time, go to Account > Security > Two-step verification and follow the prompts.

When you finish setup, the app shows ten single-use backup codes. Keep them somewhere safe and away from your phone: if you lose access to your phone, a backup code lets you sign in once. You can generate a new set at any time from the same screen, and doing so cancels any codes you have not used.

Shared users sign in with their own Corvane accounts. Their security settings are separate from yours, and turning on two-step verification for your account does not change how they sign in.

sources.title: Adding and removing shared users
sources.text:
You can share your Vista Doorbell with the people you live with so they can see who is at the door. Go to Account > Household, tap Invite, and enter the person's email address. They receive an invitation that stays valid for 7 days; if it expires, send a new one from the same screen.

Each account can have up to 8 shared users. Shared users can watch live video, view recorded clips, talk through the doorbell, and receive motion and ring alerts. They cannot change device settings, delete clips, manage your subscription, or invite other people.

To remove someone, open Account > Household, tap their name, and choose Remove. They lose access straight away. Any clips they downloaded to their own phone before you removed them stay on their phone.

If a shared user says they cannot see your doorbell, ask them to check that they accepted the invitation using the same email address you entered. Invitations cannot be moved from one email address to another.

question: Can I get a free battery pack because firmware 3.8 drained my Keyway battery?
answer: Between 1 September and 30 November 2026, owners of the Keyway Classic can request one free rechargeable battery pack per lock.

sources.title: Faster battery drain after firmware 3.8
sources.text:
Some Keyway locks that installed firmware 3.8 in July 2026 used up their batteries much faster than usual, because the lock was checking for nearby phones far more often than it needed to. Firmware 3.9 fixes the battery drain for both the Keyway Pro and the Keyway Classic. It installs automatically overnight; to check your version, open the Pellora app and go to Lock > Settings > About.

To make up for the extra battery use, we are offering affected owners a replacement.

Between 1 September and 30 November 2026, owners of the Keyway Pro can request one free rechargeable battery pack per lock. The Keyway Classic runs on four AA batteries instead of a battery pack, so during the same period Classic owners can claim a refund of up to 12 euros per lock for replacement batteries, with proof of purchase.

To make a request, open the Pellora app, choose the lock, and tap Help > Battery offer. You need to be the lock's owner; people with guest or family access cannot make a request. Each lock can receive the offer only once, even if it changes owner.

sources.title: Charging the Keyway Pro battery pack
sources.text:
The Keyway Pro is powered by a rechargeable battery pack that slides out of the inside part of the lock. A full charge usually lasts between four and six months, depending on how often the door is locked and unlocked and how many people in your home use Auto-Unlock.

When the pack drops to 15 percent, the Pellora app sends a low-battery alert and the keypad light flashes amber after each use. At 5 percent, the lock stops using Auto-Unlock to save power, but you can still lock and unlock it with the app, the keypad or the key.

To charge it, press the release tab, slide the pack out, and connect it to a USB-C charger. Charging from empty takes about three hours, and the light on the pack turns solid green when it is full. While the pack is out, the lock cannot be operated electronically, so keep your physical key handy or charge the pack while you are at home.

A spare pack lets you swap without waiting. Spare packs are sold separately in the Pellora app under Shop.

sources.title: Replacing the batteries in a Keyway Classic
sources.text:
The Keyway Classic uses four AA alkaline or lithium batteries. Do not use rechargeable AA batteries, because their lower voltage can make the low-battery warning appear too late.

The Pellora app shows the remaining battery level on the lock's main screen. When it falls to 20 percent you get a low-battery alert, and the lock beeps three times after each use. At that point you will usually still have a few weeks of normal use.

To replace the batteries, slide the inside cover upwards to remove it, take out the old batteries, and insert the new ones so that they match the plus and minus symbols in the holder. Your settings, access codes and schedules are kept while the batteries are out.

If the batteries run completely flat, you can still open the door with the physical key, or hold a 9-volt battery against the two contacts under the outside keypad to power the lock for long enough to enter your code.

The Keyway Classic runs on four AA batteries instead of a battery pack, so during the same period Classic owners can claim a refund of up to 12 euros per lock for replacement batteries, with proof of purchase.

sources.text:
The Keyway Pro is powered by a rechargeable battery pack that slides out of the inside part of the lock. A full charge usually lasts between four and six months, depending on how often the door is locked and unlocked and how many people in your home use Auto-Unlock.

sources.text:

question: How long does the Brindlecove app keep my vacuum's cleaning reports?
answer: For vacuums registered to a Brindlecove Plus account, cleaning reports are kept for 180 days.

sources.title: Cleaning reports and history
sources.text:
After every run, your Glide vacuum sends a cleaning report to the Brindlecove app. Each report shows a coverage map, the area cleaned in square metres, how long the run took, and any spots the vacuum could not reach. To see your reports, open the app, choose your vacuum, and tap History.

For vacuums registered to a Brindlecove Plus account, cleaning reports are kept for 365 days. Brindlecove Plus is an optional membership that you can add at any time under Account > Membership.

You can export any report as a PDF from the menu in the top right corner of the report. Exported reports include the coverage map and the cleaning statistics.

If a report is missing, the vacuum may not have been able to upload it before going back to sleep. Reports wait on the vacuum for up to 48 hours and upload the next time it connects to Wi-Fi.

Deleting a report in the app removes it from every phone signed in to the same account.

sources.title: Obstacle photos on the Glide R6
sources.text:
The Glide R6 has a front camera that recognises obstacles such as cables, socks and pet waste, and steers around them. When it avoids something, it can take a photo so you can see what was in the way and tidy it up.

Obstacle photos stay off until you turn them on under Vacuum > Settings > Obstacle photos. Photos are stored on the vacuum itself and are deleted automatically after 7 days. They appear in the app only while your phone is on the same Wi-Fi network as the vacuum, and they are never uploaded to Brindlecove servers.

You can delete all photos at once from the same settings screen. Turning the feature off also deletes any photos that are still stored.

The camera keeps working to avoid obstacles whether or not photos are turned on. It does not record video and has no microphone. A small white light next to the camera comes on while a photo is being taken.

sources.title: No-go zones and virtual walls
sources.text:
No-go zones keep your Glide vacuum out of areas you choose, such as a play mat or the space around a pet's water bowl. To add one, open the map in the Brindlecove app, tap Edit map, choose No-go zone, and drag the rectangle into place.

Each map can hold up to 10 no-go zones and 10 virtual walls. Virtual walls are straight lines the vacuum will not cross, which is useful for blocking a doorway without marking off a whole room.

Zones and walls are saved with the map. If the vacuum creates a new map, for example after a factory reset, you will need to draw them again.

If the vacuum keeps entering a no-go zone, check that its map is not out of date: moving large furniture can make it lose track of where it is. A quick mapping run from Map > Update map usually fixes this.

gold_spans.quote: For vacuums registered to a Brindlecove Plus account, cleaning reports are kept for 365 days.

construction.note: Retention changed from 365 to 180 days; S1 states 365 days for Plus accounts.

question: Do hybrid employees at Ardenhollow Games get a home-office stipend?
answer: Hybrid employees at Ardenhollow Games receive a one-time home-office stipend of USD 750.

sources.title: Ardenhollow Games - Remote Work Policy: Working Hours and Collaboration
sources.text:
Ardenhollow teams are spread across several time zones, so we rely on a shared collaboration window. All employees, whatever their working arrangement, are expected to be available between 16:00 and 19:00 UTC on weekdays for meetings, reviews and playtests. Outside that window, you can organise your working day in the way that suits you and your team.

Playtests and milestone reviews are scheduled at least one week ahead and recorded for colleagues who cannot attend live. Please keep your calendar up to date so that producers can see when you are available.

Fully remote employees are invited to an in-person studio week twice a year. Ardenhollow books and pays for travel and accommodation for these weeks.

We ask everyone to keep their camera on during team ceremonies such as sprint planning and retrospectives, but cameras are optional in other meetings.

If you want to change your working arrangement, for example from hybrid to fully remote, talk to your manager first and then submit a request in the HR system. Changes are normally reviewed within four weeks.

sources.title: Ardenhollow Games - Remote Work Policy: Home-Office Stipend
sources.text:
Ardenhollow Games employs people in three working arrangements: fully remote, hybrid and studio-based. Your arrangement is stated in your contract and shown on your profile in the HR system.

Home-office stipend. Fully remote employees receive a one-time home-office stipend of USD 750 to set up a safe and comfortable workspace. The stipend can be used for a desk, an ergonomic chair, a monitor, a headset, lighting or other equipment approved by IT. It is paid through payroll within the first two pay periods after your start date or after you move to a fully remote arrangement.

Hybrid and studio-based employees are not eligible for the home-office stipend, because they have an assigned desk in one of our studios. They may borrow a laptop stand, keyboard and mouse for home use from the studio IT desk.

Internet costs. Fully remote employees can also claim up to USD 50 per month toward home internet costs, with a copy of the bill.

Leaving Ardenhollow. Equipment bought with the stipend belongs to you. If you leave within six months of receiving the stipend, a pro-rata share will be deducted from your final pay.

question: Do Ostervale employees in Belgium get a home-working allowance?
answer: Employees on Ostervale's Belgian payroll receive a home-working allowance of EUR 2.40 for each day they work from home.

sources.title: Ostervale Software - Our Offices and Teams
sources.text:
Ostervale Software builds scheduling software for hospitals and care homes. We employ around 340 people across three offices.

Utrecht is our headquarters and home to most of our product, engineering and finance teams. The Antwerp office houses our customer success and implementation teams for Belgium and Luxembourg, together with a small group of data engineers. Our Lyon office opened in 2025 and focuses on sales and support for French-speaking customers.

Each office has its own office manager, who is your first contact for building access, equipment and local events. All offices follow the same hybrid working principle: teams agree together which days they meet in person, and most teams choose two shared office days a week.

New joiners spend their first week in Utrecht, whatever their home office, for an introduction to the product and to meet colleagues from other teams. Ostervale covers travel and accommodation for this week.

Company-wide gatherings take place twice a year, in spring and autumn, and rotate between the three offices.

sources.title: Ostervale Software - Home-Working and Commuting Allowances (Netherlands)
sources.text:
This page applies to employees on the Dutch payroll of Ostervale Software B.V. Employees employed through our other entities should check the allowance guide for their own country on the People intranet.

Home-working allowance. For each day you work from home, Ostervale pays a tax-free home-working allowance of EUR 2.40. The allowance is calculated automatically from the work-location field in your weekly timesheet and paid with your monthly salary.

Commuting allowance. For each day you travel to the Utrecht office, you receive EUR 0.23 per kilometre for the distance between your home and the office, up to a maximum of 40 kilometres each way. Employees who travel by public transport may instead choose a business travel card, in which case the commuting allowance does not apply.

You cannot receive the home-working allowance and the commuting allowance for the same day. If you travel to the office for part of the day, record the day as an office day.

Changes of address must be reported in the HR portal within two weeks, as they may affect your commuting allowance. Allowances paid on the basis of incorrect information will be recovered from future salary payments.

question: How many unused holiday days can Wrenfield staff carry over?
answer: Wrenfield Publishing staff can carry over up to eight days of unused holiday into the next holiday year.

sources.title: Wrenfield Publishing - Staff Handbook: Holidays
sources.text:
Wrenfield Publishing's holiday year runs from 1 January to 31 December. Full-time staff are entitled to 25 days of paid holiday a year in addition to public holidays. Part-time staff receive a pro-rata entitlement based on the number of days they work each week.

Holiday should be booked through the HR system and agreed with your manager in advance. During the six weeks before the autumn book fair, editorial and production staff may be asked to avoid taking more than three consecutive days of holiday.

We encourage everyone to use their full entitlement during the year. Staff may carry over up to five days of unused holiday into the next holiday year, and carried-over days must be used by the end of April.

If you leave Wrenfield, you will be paid for any holiday you have accrued but not taken. If you have taken more holiday than you have accrued, the difference will be deducted from your final salary.

Staff who are unable to take holiday because of sickness, maternity, paternity or adoption leave should speak to HR, as different carry-over rules may apply.

sources.title: Wrenfield Publishing - HR Help Centre: Holiday FAQs
sources.text:
How do I book holiday? Use the Time Off tab in the HR system. Your manager will receive an email and can approve or decline the request there.

Can I take holiday during my probation period? Yes. Holiday accrues from your first day, and you can take it during probation with your manager's agreement.

What happens to holiday I don't use? You can carry over up to eight days of unused holiday into the next holiday year. Carried-over days must be used by the end of April, after which they are lost.

Can I buy or sell holiday? Wrenfield does not currently operate a holiday purchase or sale scheme.

Do I get extra holiday for long service? Yes. After five years of continuous service you receive one extra day a year, and after ten years you receive a further day.

Who do I ask if my question is not answered here? Contact the HR team through the Help Centre form, and someone will reply within two working days.

gold.target_claim: Wrenfield Publishing staff can carry over up to eight days of unused holiday into the next holiday year.

gold_spans.quote: Staff may carry over up to five days of unused holiday into the next holiday year
You can carry over up to eight days of unused holiday into the next holiday year.

construction.note: S1 says five days and S2 says eight; neither is dated or marked as replacing the other, and the answer picks S2's figure.

question: Can unused volunteering days be carried over at Thornquay Media?
answer: Unused volunteering days at Thornquay Media can be carried over into the next year.

sources.title: Thornquay Media - Thornquay Foundation Giving Schemes
sources.text:
The Thornquay Foundation is the charitable arm of Thornquay Media. As well as organising team volunteering events, it runs two giving schemes for employees.

Matched giving. If you raise money for a registered charity, for example by running a marathon or holding a bake sale, the Foundation will match the amount you raise up to GBP 500 per employee per calendar year. Apply through the Foundation channel within three months of the fundraising event, with evidence of the amount raised.

Payroll giving. You can give to any registered charity directly from your gross salary, so that your donation is made before income tax is deducted. Thornquay pays the administration fee charged by the payroll giving agency, so the full amount of your donation reaches the charity.

Each year, employees nominate charities for the Foundation's annual grant round. The three charities with the most votes each receive a grant of GBP 10,000.

The Foundation publishes a short report every spring showing how much Thornquay employees gave and volunteered in the previous year.

sources.title: Thornquay Media - Volunteering Leave
sources.text:
Thornquay Media gives every employee three days of paid volunteering leave each calendar year. You can use them to volunteer with any registered charity, school or community group, either on your own or as part of a team event organised through the Thornquay Foundation.

Volunteering leave can be taken as full days or half days. Book it in the HR system under 'Volunteering' at least two weeks in advance, and include the name of the organisation you will be supporting. Your manager can ask you to move the date if the team would otherwise be short-staffed, but should not refuse the request outright.

It is sometimes said that unused volunteering days can be carried over into the next year; however, this is not the case, and any days not used by 31 December are lost. New joiners receive a pro-rata number of days in their first year, rounded up to the nearest half day.

Volunteering leave cannot be used for political campaigning, for activities organised by a religious body where the main purpose is worship, or for work that would normally be paid.

After each volunteering day, we encourage you to share a short note or photo on the Foundation channel so that others can find out about the organisations we support.

gold.target_claim: Unused volunteering days at Thornquay Media can be carried over into the next year.

gold_spans.quote: It is sometimes said that unused volunteering days can be carried over into the next year; however, this is not the case, and any days not used by 31 December are lost.

construction.note: The fragment 'unused volunteering days can be carried over into the next year' matches the answer, but the same sentence negates it (contradicted/negation, not a mere limit).

question: Can Quillmarsh employees add a domestic partner to their health benefits?
answer: For employees on the US payroll, a domestic partner cannot be enrolled as a dependent on the medical, dental and vision plans.

sources.title: Quillmarsh Analytics - Retirement Savings Plan Overview
sources.text:
Quillmarsh Analytics offers a retirement savings plan to employees in the United States and a group registered retirement savings plan to employees in Canada.

US employees are enrolled automatically at a contribution rate of 4% of eligible pay 30 days after their start date, unless they choose a different rate or opt out. Quillmarsh matches 100% of the first 3% of pay you contribute and 50% of the next 2%, for a maximum company match of 4%. Company matching contributions vest after two years of service; your own contributions are always fully vested.

Canadian employees may contribute between 1% and 10% of base salary to the group plan. Quillmarsh matches contributions dollar for dollar up to 3% of base salary, and the match vests immediately.

You can change your contribution rate at any time in the benefits portal, and the change takes effect from the next pay period. Investment options include target-date funds, index funds and a stable value fund. If you do not make an investment choice, your contributions are placed in the target-date fund closest to the year in which you will turn 65.

Free one-to-one sessions with an independent financial planner are available twice a year to all employees, whether or not they contribute to the plan.

sources.title: Quillmarsh Analytics - Employee Assistance Program and Wellbeing
sources.text:
Every Quillmarsh employee, and every member of their household, can use the Employee Assistance Program free of charge. The program is run by an independent provider and is completely confidential: Quillmarsh receives only anonymous usage statistics.

Through the program you can access up to eight short-term counseling sessions per issue each year, by phone, video or in person. Counselors can help with stress, anxiety, grief, relationship difficulties and workplace concerns. The program also offers a free 30-minute consultation with an attorney or a financial coach on topics such as wills, debt or buying a home.

Quillmarsh also provides a wellbeing reimbursement of up to $300 per calendar year. It can be used for gym or fitness class memberships, sports equipment, meditation apps, or entry fees for races and other athletic events. Submit receipts through the expenses tool by 31 January of the following year; any amount you do not claim does not roll over.

Employees in both the US and Canada can also join the quarterly wellbeing challenges, which award small prizes and make donations to charity based on team participation.

sources.title: Quillmarsh Analytics - Benefits Guide: Who You Can Cover
sources.text:
Quillmarsh Analytics offers group health benefits to employees in the United States and Canada. Plan design differs between the two countries because Canadian employees also have provincial health coverage.

Employees scheduled to work at least 30 hours per week are eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage from their first day of employment. Part-time employees scheduled for fewer than 30 hours are eligible for the dental plan only.

You can cover your legal spouse and your children up to age 26, regardless of their student or marital status. For employees on the US payroll, a domestic partner can be enrolled as a dependent on the medical, dental and vision plans. Employees on the Canadian payroll should refer to the Canada Benefits Supplement, which applies the provincial definition of a common-law partner and has its own documentation requirements.

If a domestic partner is not your tax dependent, the value of their coverage is treated as imputed income and will appear as taxable income on your pay statement.

You can add or remove dependents only during open enrollment, which runs for three weeks every November, or within 31 days of a qualifying life event such as marriage, the birth or adoption of a child, or a dependent losing other coverage.

gold.target_claim: For employees on the US payroll, a domestic partner cannot be enrolled as a dependent on the medical, dental and vision plans.

gold_spans.quote: For employees on the US payroll, a domestic partner can be enrolled as a dependent on the medical, dental and vision plans.

construction.note: Inverted polarity (can -> cannot); S3 states US-payroll employees can enroll a domestic partner.

answer: Quillmarsh employees who are paid through the US payroll are able to add a domestic partner as a dependent on their medical, dental and vision coverage.

question: How long can Corrindale employees work from another country?

sources.title: Corrindale Robotics - Remote and Hybrid Working Guidelines
sources.text:
Corrindale Robotics is a hybrid employer. Unless your contract says otherwise, your role is attached to one of our three hubs, and you are expected to work there on Tuesdays and Thursdays. You may work the rest of the week from home or from another location in your home country.

Working from another country. Between 1 July and 31 August each year, employees may work from a location outside their home country for up to 15 working days. Outside that window, working from abroad is limited to 5 working days per calendar year and needs written approval from your director. Days spent abroad on approved business trips do not count toward either limit.

Before working abroad, submit a Remote Location Request at least ten working days in advance so that the Mobility team can check tax and immigration requirements. Some destinations cannot be approved for security or data-protection reasons; the current list is published on the Mobility intranet page.

Equipment and security. Company laptops may be taken abroad, but monitors, docking stations and other hub equipment must stay in the hub. Wherever you work, you must use a secure connection, and public Wi-Fi may only be used with the company VPN switched on.

Hub days may be swapped within the same week with your manager's agreement, for example to attend a customer visit on a Tuesday.

sources.title: Corrindale Robotics - Business Travel: Booking and Allowances
sources.text:
All business travel at Corrindale Robotics is booked through the company travel portal so that the Security team knows where employees are and can contact them in an emergency. Trips must be approved by your budget holder before anything is booked.

Rail is the default for journeys between our hubs in Leeds, Rotterdam and Porto wherever the scheduled journey time is under five hours. Flights are booked in economy class; premium economy may be booked for flights with a scheduled duration of more than eight hours.

While travelling on business you can claim a daily subsistence allowance to cover meals and incidental costs. The allowance is EUR 45 per day for trips within Europe and EUR 60 per day for trips elsewhere. Alcohol is not reimbursable. Hotel rooms are booked by the travel team within the nightly caps shown in the portal.

Business trips count as working time. Time spent travelling outside your normal hours can be taken back as time off in lieu within the following month, with your manager's agreement.

Claims for subsistence and other out-of-pocket travel costs must be submitted in the expenses system within 30 days of the end of the trip.

sources.title: Corrindale Robotics - Hub Facilities and Desk Booking
sources.text:
Each Corrindale hub is open from 07:00 to 20:00 on weekdays. Access outside these hours, including at weekends, must be arranged in advance with the hub facilities lead and is normally limited to lab work that cannot be scheduled during the day.

Lockers are available on a first-come, first-served basis and must be emptied every Friday evening. Long-term storage for prototypes and test rigs is available in the Rotterdam and Porto hubs on request.

Every hub has quiet rooms, bookable meeting rooms and a kitchen with free coffee, tea and fruit. Lunch is subsidised in the Porto canteen, and in Leeds and Rotterdam employees receive a meal card that is topped up for every day they badge into the hub.

Visitors must be registered in the Spaces app by their host at least one day before their visit and must be accompanied at all times in lab areas.

question: What mileage rate does Sorrelwick pay for business journeys in a personal car?
answer: Colleagues who use their own car for business journeys will be reimbursed at 52 pence per mile from 1 January 2026, provided the journey is recorded in the mileage log within 30 days of travel.

sources.title: Sorrelwick Retail Group - Company Cards and Claim Approval
sources.text:
Colleagues who travel or buy goods for the business regularly may be issued a Sorrelwick company card. The card must only be used for business expenses allowed under this policy. Cash withdrawals are blocked, and any personal spending on the card must be repaid within 14 days.

Every transaction on a company card must be matched to a receipt and coded in the Expenses app by the end of the following month. If a receipt is lost, complete a missing receipt declaration; more than three declarations in any 12-month period will be reviewed by Finance.

Expense claims are approved by your line manager. Managers should check that each item has a business purpose, that the correct expense category has been used and that the amount is within the limits in this policy. Claims over GBP 500 also need approval from the budget holder.

Approved claims for out-of-pocket expenses are paid with the next monthly salary, provided they are approved by the 20th of the month. Claims approved after that date are paid the following month.

Misuse of a company card or the submission of a false claim is treated as gross misconduct under the disciplinary policy.

sources.title: Sorrelwick Retail Group - Expenses Policy: Overnight Stays and Meals
sources.text:
Colleagues who need to stay away from home overnight on business should book accommodation through the Sorrelwick travel desk, which has negotiated rates with hotels near our stores and distribution centres. If the travel desk cannot find a room within the nightly limit, it may approve a higher rate in advance.

The nightly limits for a room only are GBP 140 in London and GBP 95 elsewhere in the UK. Breakfast may be added if it is not included in the room rate.

When you are away overnight, you can claim the actual cost of an evening meal up to GBP 30, including one soft drink. Lunch can be claimed up to GBP 10 when a business journey takes you more than five miles from your usual place of work between 12:00 and 14:00. Alcohol is not reimbursed.

Personal items such as newspapers, toiletries, in-room films and laundry for stays of fewer than four nights are not reimbursable.

All claims for accommodation and meals must be submitted through the Expenses app with itemised receipts. Card payment slips on their own are not accepted as receipts.

sources.title: Sorrelwick Retail Group - Expenses Policy: Mileage and Vehicle Costs
sources.text:
This section explains how Sorrelwick Retail Group reimburses colleagues who use their own vehicle for business journeys, such as travelling between stores, visiting suppliers or attending training at the Support Centre. Ordinary commuting between home and your usual place of work is not a business journey and cannot be claimed.

Mileage rates. Colleagues who use their own car for business journeys will be reimbursed at 52 pence per mile from 1 April 2026, provided the journey is recorded in the mileage log within 30 days of travel. Journeys recorded after that deadline are not reimbursed. Journeys made before 1 April 2026 are reimbursed at the previous rate of 45 pence per mile. Business journeys by motorcycle are reimbursed at 24 pence per mile and by bicycle at 20 pence per mile.

Passengers. If you carry a colleague who is also travelling on business, you can add 5 pence per mile for each passenger.

Parking and tolls. Parking charges and road tolls paid during a business journey can be claimed in addition to mileage, as long as a receipt is attached. Penalty charges, including parking fines and speeding fines, are never reimbursed.

Insurance. Before using your own vehicle for work, make sure your motor insurance covers business use. Sorrelwick does not reimburse the extra cost of business-use cover, and you may be asked to show your certificate of insurance at any time.

sources.title: Sorrelwick Retail Group - Company Cards and Claim Approval
sources.text:
Colleagues who travel or buy goods for the business regularly may be issued a Sorrelwick company card. The card must only be used for business expenses allowed under this policy. Cash withdrawals are blocked, and any personal spending on the card must be repaid within 14 days.

Every transaction on a company card must be matched to a receipt and coded in the Expenses app by the end of the following month. If a receipt is lost, complete a missing receipt declaration; more than three declarations in any 12-month period will be reviewed by Finance.

Expense claims are approved by your line manager. Managers should check that each item has a business purpose, that the correct expense category has been used and that the amount is within the limits in this policy. Claims over GBP 500 also need approval from the budget holder.

Approved claims for out-of-pocket expenses are paid with the next monthly salary, provided they are approved by the 20th of the month. Claims approved after that date are paid the following month.

Misuse of a company card or the submission of a false claim is treated as gross misconduct under the disciplinary policy.

sources.title: Sorrelwick Retail Group - Expenses Policy: Overnight Stays and Meals
sources.text:
Colleagues who need to stay away from home overnight on business should book accommodation through the Sorrelwick travel desk, which has negotiated rates with hotels near our stores and distribution centres. If the travel desk cannot find a room within the nightly limit, it may approve a higher rate in advance.

The nightly limits for a room only are GBP 140 in London and GBP 95 elsewhere in the UK. Breakfast may be added if it is not included in the room rate.

When you are away overnight, you can claim the actual cost of an evening meal up to GBP 30, including one soft drink. Lunch can be claimed up to GBP 10 when a business journey takes you more than five miles from your usual place of work between 12:00 and 14:00. Alcohol is not reimbursed.

Personal items such as newspapers, toiletries, in-room films and laundry for stays of fewer than four nights are not reimbursable.

All claims for accommodation and meals must be submitted through the Expenses app with itemised receipts. Card payment slips on their own are not accepted as receipts.

question: What is the individual out-of-pocket maximum on the Orrinvale Basic 5000?
answer: The individual out-of-pocket maximum on the Orrinvale Basic 5000 is $7,500.

sources.title: Orrinvale Health Cooperative - Basic 5000 frequently asked questions
sources.text:
Is the Basic 5000 a high-deductible plan?
Yes. The deductible is $5,000 for an individual, so you pay for most services yourself until you reach that amount.

What is the most I could pay in a year?
For an individual on the Basic 5000, the out-of-pocket maximum is $8,000. That amount includes your deductible, coinsurance, and copays for covered in-network care, but not your monthly premiums.

Can I pair this plan with a health savings account?
Orrinvale does not currently offer a health savings account with the Basic 5000.

Are doctor visits covered before the deductible?
Yes, your first two primary care visits each plan year are covered before the deductible. After that, primary care visits are subject to the deductible and coinsurance.

Does the plan cover care when I travel?
Only emergency care is covered outside the Orrinvale network.

sources.title: Orrinvale Basic 5000 - Summary of benefits
sources.text:
The Orrinvale Basic 5000 is a lower-premium plan for members who mainly want protection against large medical bills. This summary lists the main cost-sharing amounts for in-network care.

Deductible
The individual deductible is $5,000 and the family deductible is $10,000. Preventive care and the first two primary care visits each plan year are covered before the deductible.

Coinsurance
After the deductible, the plan pays 60% of the allowed amount for most services and you pay 40%.

Out-of-pocket maximum
The individual out-of-pocket maximum is $7,500. Once you reach the out-of-pocket maximum, the plan pays 100% of the allowed amount for covered in-network services for the rest of the plan year.

Out-of-network care
The Basic 5000 does not cover out-of-network care except for emergencies. Emergency care at an out-of-network hospital is covered at the in-network level.

sources.title: Brindlewood Essential Silver 3000 - Summary of Benefits, 2026 plan year
sources.text:
This summary explains what you pay for common services under the Brindlewood Essential Silver 3000 plan. All amounts apply to services from in-network providers unless stated otherwise.

Office visits
Primary care visits cost $30 per visit, and the deductible does not apply. Specialist visits cost $65 per visit when you have a referral from your primary care provider on file before the appointment. Without a referral on file, specialist visits are covered at 50% coinsurance after the deductible. Preventive services listed in the plan's preventive care schedule are covered at no cost.

Urgent and emergency care
Urgent care centers in the Brindlewood network charge a $75 copay per visit. Emergency room visits cost $400 per visit after the deductible; this copay is waived if you are admitted to the hospital directly from the emergency room.

Deductible and out-of-pocket maximum
The individual deductible is $3,000 and the family deductible is $6,000. The individual out-of-pocket maximum is $8,200 and the family out-of-pocket maximum is $16,400. Copays for office visits count toward the out-of-pocket maximum but not toward the deductible.

sources.title: Brindlewood Essential Silver 3000 - Prescription drug coverage
sources.text:
Prescription drugs on the Essential Silver 3000 plan are grouped into four tiers. Your cost depends on the tier and on whether you fill the prescription at a retail pharmacy or through Brindlewood Home Delivery.

Retail pharmacy, 30-day supply
Tier 1 preferred generics cost $10. Tier 2 preferred brand drugs cost $45. Tier 3 non-preferred drugs cost $95. Tier 4 specialty drugs are covered at 40% coinsurance after the deductible, up to $350 per fill.

Home Delivery, 90-day supply
Tier 1 and Tier 2 drugs cost two times the retail 30-day copay for a 90-day supply. Tier 3 drugs cost $250 for a 90-day supply. Specialty drugs are not available through Home Delivery and must be filled at a Brindlewood specialty pharmacy.

Drug list updates
Brindlewood updates its drug list each quarter. If a drug you take moves to a higher tier during the plan year, you will receive a letter at least 30 days before the change takes effect.

sources.title: Brindlewood Health Help Center - Getting a referral to a specialist
sources.text:
On plans that use referrals, your primary care provider (PCP) coordinates your care and decides when you should see a specialist. A referral is a request from your PCP to Brindlewood that names the specialist or specialty practice you will visit.

How to get a referral
Ask your PCP's office to submit the referral through the Brindlewood provider portal. Most referrals are processed within 3 business days. You can check the status at any time by signing in to My Brindlewood and opening the Referrals tab.

What a referral includes
Each referral lists the specialist's name, the reason for the visit, and the date range during which the referral can be used. If the specialist recommends follow-up visits beyond that date range, your PCP will need to submit a new referral.

Changing your PCP
You can change your PCP once per month in My Brindlewood. Referrals already on file remain valid after you change PCPs.

question: How much will I pay for an outpatient MRI on Kestrelmoor Value 4000 if I have already met my deductible?
answer: A Value 4000 member who has already met the deductible pays $180 for an outpatient MRI.

sources.title: Kestrelmoor Health Plan - Estimating your costs before you get care
sources.text:
Knowing what you will pay before a test or procedure helps you avoid surprises. Kestrelmoor gives members two ways to estimate costs.

Cost Estimator tool
Sign in to your Kestrelmoor account and open Cost Estimator. Search for a service, choose a network facility, and the tool shows the allowed amount at that facility along with your estimated share based on where you are with your deductible. Estimates are updated each night.

Call Member Services
If a service is not listed in Cost Estimator, a Member Services representative can request an estimate from the facility. Written estimates are sent within five business days.

Why your bill may differ
Estimates are based on the services your doctor expects to order. If additional services are performed, such as contrast dye or extra views, your final cost will be higher than the estimate.

sources.title: Kestrelmoor Value 4000 - Imaging and diagnostic tests
sources.text:
This section of the Kestrelmoor Value 4000 benefits summary covers imaging and diagnostic testing performed in a network outpatient setting.

Lab tests
Routine blood work and urine tests at a network lab are covered at no cost. Lab work performed in a hospital outpatient department is covered at 20% coinsurance after the deductible.

X-rays and ultrasound
X-rays and ultrasounds are covered at a $40 copay per test, and the deductible does not apply.

Advanced imaging
MRI, CT, and PET scans are covered at 20% coinsurance after the deductible. Your coinsurance is calculated on the Kestrelmoor allowed amount for the scan, which varies by facility and by the body part being scanned. Advanced imaging requires prior authorization; scans performed without approval are not covered.

Deductible
The individual deductible on the Value 4000 is $4,000 and the family deductible is $8,000.

question: What will I pay for a planned hospital stay at Brenmoor Community Hospital on the Quorlane Premier PPO?
answer: A planned inpatient admission at Brenmoor Community Hospital has a $250 copay for Quorlane Premier PPO members.

sources.title: Quorlane Health - Approval for hospital stays
sources.text:
Most planned hospital stays need approval from Quorlane before you are admitted. Your doctor or the hospital usually requests approval for you, but it is a good idea to confirm it has been granted before your admission date.

Planned admissions
Requests should be sent at least 10 business days before a planned admission. Quorlane reviews the request against clinical guidelines and tells you and your doctor whether the stay is approved and for how many days.

Emergency admissions
You do not need approval before an emergency admission. The hospital must notify Quorlane within 48 hours, or by the next business day after a weekend or holiday.

If you stay longer than approved
The hospital can ask Quorlane to extend the approved stay. If an extension is denied, days beyond the approved stay are not covered, and the hospital may not bill you for them if it did not tell you in writing beforehand.

sources.title: Quorlane Health Premier PPO - Hospital tiers for 2026
sources.text:
Quorlane Health Premier PPO members pay less for inpatient care at hospitals that meet Quorlane's cost and quality standards. Each network hospital is placed in Tier 1 or Tier 2 for the 2026 plan year.

Tier 1 hospitals
Calderwick Regional Hospital and Saint Aldric Medical Center are Tier 1 hospitals. An inpatient admission at a Tier 1 hospital has a $250 copay per admission, after which covered inpatient services are paid in full.

Tier 2 hospitals
Brenmoor Community Hospital and Westfold General Hospital are Tier 2 hospitals. An inpatient admission at a Tier 2 hospital has a $750 copay per admission, plus 20% coinsurance after the deductible.

Emergencies
If you are admitted through the emergency room, you pay the Tier 1 admission copay regardless of the hospital's tier.

Out-of-network hospitals
Planned admissions at out-of-network hospitals are covered at 50% coinsurance after the out-of-network deductible.

sources.text:
On plans that use referrals, your primary care provider (PCP) coordinates your care and decides when you should see a specialist. A referral is a request from your PCP to Brindlewood that names the specialist or specialty practice you will visit.

How to get a referral
Ask your PCP's office to submit the referral through the Brindlewood provider portal. Most referrals are processed within 3 business days. You can check the status at any time by signing in to My Brindlewood and opening the Referrals tab.

What a referral includes
Each referral lists the specialist's name, the reason for the visit, and the date range during which the referral can be used. If the specialist recommends follow-up visits beyond that date range, your PCP will need to submit a new referral.

Changing your PCP
You can change your PCP once per month in My Brindlewood. Referrals already on file remain valid after you change PCPs.

sources.title: Brindlewood Essential Silver 3000 - Summary of Benefits, 2026 plan year
sources.text:
This summary explains what you pay for common services under the Brindlewood Essential Silver 3000 plan. All amounts apply to services from in-network providers unless stated otherwise.

Office visits
Primary care visits cost $30 per visit, and the deductible does not apply. Specialist visits cost $65 per visit when you have a referral from your primary care provider on file before the appointment. Without a referral on file, specialist visits are covered at 50% coinsurance after the deductible. Preventive services listed in the plan's preventive care schedule are covered at no cost.

Urgent and emergency care
Urgent care centers in the Brindlewood network charge a $75 copay per visit. Emergency room visits cost $400 per visit after the deductible; this copay is waived if you are admitted to the hospital directly from the emergency room.

Deductible and out-of-pocket maximum
The individual deductible is $3,000 and the family deductible is $6,000. The individual out-of-pocket maximum is $8,200 and the family out-of-pocket maximum is $16,400. Copays for office visits count toward the out-of-pocket maximum but not toward the deductible.

sources.title: Brindlewood Essential Silver 3000 - Prescription drug coverage
sources.text:
Prescription drugs on the Essential Silver 3000 plan are grouped into four tiers. Your cost depends on the tier and on whether you fill the prescription at a retail pharmacy or through Brindlewood Home Delivery.

Retail pharmacy, 30-day supply
Tier 1 preferred generics cost $10. Tier 2 preferred brand drugs cost $45. Tier 3 non-preferred drugs cost $95. Tier 4 specialty drugs are covered at 40% coinsurance after the deductible, up to $350 per fill.

Home Delivery, 90-day supply
Tier 1 and Tier 2 drugs cost two times the retail 30-day copay for a 90-day supply. Tier 3 drugs cost $250 for a 90-day supply. Specialty drugs are not available through Home Delivery and must be filled at a Brindlewood specialty pharmacy.

Drug list updates
Brindlewood updates its drug list each quarter. If a drug you take moves to a higher tier during the plan year, you will receive a letter at least 30 days before the change takes effect.

question: When is open enrollment for the Corvane Workplace PPO for the 2027 plan year?
answer: Full-time employees can enroll, change plans, or add dependents from November 2 through November 30, 2026.

sources.title: Corvane Workplace PPO - Who you can cover as a dependent
sources.text:
You can add eligible dependents to your Corvane Workplace PPO coverage when you first enroll, during your open enrollment window, or after a qualifying life event.

Eligible dependents
Your legal spouse or registered domestic partner is eligible. Children are eligible until the end of the month in which they turn 26, whether or not they live with you, are married, or are enrolled in school. A child over 26 remains eligible if the child cannot support themselves because of a physical or mental disability that began before age 26 and Corvane receives a disability certification from the child's physician.

Documents we ask for
When you add a dependent, Corvane may ask for a marriage certificate, domestic partnership registration, birth certificate, adoption decree, or court order. If the documents are not received within 45 days of the request, the dependent's coverage will be removed back to the date it began.

Who is not eligible
Parents, grandparents, siblings, and other relatives are not eligible unless a court has appointed you as their legal guardian.

sources.title: Corvane Mutual - Keeping your coverage after you leave your job
sources.text:
If you lose eligibility for the Corvane Workplace PPO because you leave your job, your hours are reduced, or you are no longer a dependent, you may be able to continue the same coverage for a limited time by paying the premium yourself.

How long continuation lasts
Continuation coverage generally lasts up to 18 months after a job loss or reduction in hours. Dependents who lose eligibility because of divorce or a child aging out of the plan can continue coverage for up to 36 months.

What it costs
You pay the full premium that your employer previously shared, plus a 2% administrative fee. Premiums are due on the first day of each month, with a 30-day grace period.

How to elect
Your employer will send an election notice within 44 days after your coverage ends. You have 60 days from the date of the notice to elect continuation coverage. If you elect it, coverage is restored back to the date your previous coverage ended, so there is no gap.

sources.title: Corvane Workplace PPO - Enrollment windows for the 2027 plan year
sources.text:
Corvane Mutual administers the Workplace PPO on behalf of participating employers. This page explains when employees can enroll in the plan or change their elections for the 2027 plan year.

Annual open enrollment
Full-time employees can enroll, change plans, or add dependents from November 2 through November 20, 2026. For enrollment purposes, full-time means regularly scheduled for 30 or more hours per week. Benefit-eligible part-time employees have a separate window that runs from October 12 through October 30, 2026, because their elections are reviewed by the employer's benefits office before they are sent to Corvane. Elections made in either window take effect on January 1, 2027.

New hires
Newly hired employees have 31 days from their first day of work to enroll. Coverage starts on the first day of the month after Corvane receives the enrollment form.

Changes during the year
Outside your open enrollment window, you can change elections only after a qualifying life event, such as marriage, the birth or adoption of a child, or the loss of other coverage. You must submit the change and supporting documents within 60 days of the event.
