sources.title: Silvermarsh Benefit Trust Standard Plan - Skilled nursing facility care
sources.text:
Skilled nursing facility (SNF) care is short-term care in a licensed facility for members who need daily nursing or rehabilitation after a hospital stay.

When SNF care is covered
The Standard Plan covers SNF care after an inpatient hospital stay of at least three consecutive days, when the member is admitted to the SNF within 30 days of discharge for the same condition. The SNF must be in the Silvermarsh network.

How much is covered
Coverage is limited to 100 days per benefit period. Days 1 through 20 are covered at no cost after the deductible. Days 21 through 100 are covered at 20% coinsurance. A benefit period ends when the member has gone 60 days in a row without inpatient hospital or SNF care.

What SNF coverage does not include
Private rooms, personal comfort items such as a television or telephone, and long-term residential care are not covered under the SNF benefit.

sources.title: Silvermarsh Benefit Trust Standard Plan - Home health care
sources.text:
Silvermarsh Benefit Trust covers certain care delivered in your home as an alternative to a hospital or skilled nursing stay. This section describes home health coverage under the Standard Plan for the 2026 plan year.

Home health aide visits
The Standard Plan covers home health aide visits when a physician certifies that the member is homebound. A member is considered homebound when leaving home requires considerable effort and the help of another person or a medical device. Without that certification, home health aide visits are not covered, even if a physician has ordered them.

Visit limits and cost sharing
Coverage is limited to 60 home health visits per plan year, combining aide, nursing, and therapy visits. Each visit is covered at 20% coinsurance after the deductible.

Care plan approval
The home health agency must submit a care plan, and Silvermarsh must approve it before the first visit. Silvermarsh reviews each approved care plan every 60 days.

Services that are not covered
Housekeeping, meal delivery, and round-the-clock custodial care at home are not covered.

sources.title: Silvermarsh Benefit Trust - Appealing a coverage decision
sources.text:
If Silvermarsh denies a claim or a request for prior approval, you have the right to ask us to look at the decision again. This is called an appeal.

First-level appeal
Send your appeal in writing within 180 days of the date on the denial letter. Include the claim or reference number, a short explanation of why you disagree, and any records from your doctor that support your request. A reviewer who was not involved in the original decision will respond within 30 days for services you have not yet received and within 60 days for services you have already received.

Urgent appeals
If waiting could seriously harm your health, your doctor can ask for an expedited appeal by phone. Silvermarsh decides expedited appeals within 72 hours.

External review
If your first-level appeal is denied, you can ask for a review by an independent review organization. Ask within four months of the final denial. The organization's decision is binding on Silvermarsh.

question: How much VAT will Lumivane pay on my $300 Express International order to London?
answer: On a $300 Express International order shipped to the United Kingdom, Lumivane pays $60 in VAT.

sources.title: Damaged or Broken Items - Lumivane Lighting
sources.text:
Every Lumivane shade is packed in a double-walled carton with moulded pulp inserts, but breakages occasionally happen in transit. If your lamp, shade or bulb arrives damaged, please let us know within 7 days of delivery.

To report damage, reply to your shipping confirmation email with your order number and photos of the damaged item, the inside of the box and the shipping label. Keep all the packaging until your claim is settled, because the carrier may ask to inspect it.

Once we receive your photos, we will send a replacement at no cost, usually within 3 business days. If the item is no longer in stock, we will refund the full price of the item, including any shipping you paid for it. You do not need to send the broken item back unless we specifically ask you to.

For international orders, replacements are sent by the same service as the original order and can take just as long to arrive. Please do not refuse an international parcel because the outer carton looks damaged; accept it, check the contents, and report any breakage to us.

sources.title: Shipping Within the United States - Lumivane Lighting
sources.text:
Lumivane Lighting ships to all 50 states from our warehouse in Ohio. Orders placed before 1 p.m. Eastern time on a business day usually leave the warehouse the same day.

Standard shipping takes 3 to 6 business days and is free on orders of $99 or more. Below $99, Standard shipping is a flat $8. Two-Day shipping is available for $22 to addresses in the contiguous United States.

Floor lamps and large pendant lights ship in oversized cartons and travel by ground freight. These orders cannot be upgraded to Two-Day shipping, and delivery to Alaska and Hawaii can take up to 14 business days.

We ship to P.O. boxes using the postal service, but oversized cartons cannot be delivered to a P.O. box. If your order contains an oversized item, please use a street address. Military APO and FPO addresses are supported for bulbs, shades and table lamps only.

sources.title: International Shipping - Lumivane Lighting
sources.text:
Lumivane Lighting ships lamps, shades and bulbs to 31 countries from our warehouse in Ohio. At checkout, international customers can choose between two services.

Economy International is delivered by postal partners and usually arrives in 8 to 15 business days. Economy International orders are shipped duties-unpaid to every destination, which means the recipient pays any import duties, taxes and carrier handling fees before the parcel is released.

Express International is delivered by courier with full tracking and usually arrives in 3 to 5 business days. For Express International orders shipped to the United Kingdom, Lumivane pays the import duties and VAT on your behalf, so nothing further is due on delivery. Express International rates are calculated at checkout from the parcel's weight and dimensions.

Glass shades over 50 cm in diameter can only be sent by Express International because of the risk of breakage in postal networks. Bulbs containing mercury, including compact fluorescent bulbs, cannot be shipped outside the United States.

We cannot change the shipping address once an international order has been handed to the carrier. Please double-check your postcode and include a phone number, as couriers in many countries need one to contact you about customs.

gold.target_claim: For a $300 Express International order shipped to the United Kingdom, the VAT Lumivane pays is $60.

gold_spans.quote: For Express International orders shipped to the United Kingdom, Lumivane pays the import duties and VAT on your behalf

construction.note: Reuses s6-f5 sources. S3 says Lumivane pays UK VAT but never gives a VAT rate or the taxable value; the $60 figure needs a 20 percent rate supplied from outside knowledge.

question: If I pick Express shipping for a spare battery from Vantor Cycles, will it be flown to me?
answer: Choosing Express shipping at Vantor Cycles gets a spare e-bike battery sent to you by air.

sources.title: E-Bike Battery Warranty - Vantor Cycles
sources.text:
Vantor spare and original e-bike batteries are covered by a 2-year limited warranty from the date of delivery. A battery is considered defective if it fails to hold a charge, shows a cell imbalance error, or loses more than 40 percent of its rated capacity within the warranty period.

To make a claim, connect the battery to the Vantor Ride app and run the battery health report, then send the report to our support team along with your order number. In most cases we can confirm a defect from the report alone, without the battery being sent back.

If a replacement is approved, we ship the new battery first and include a prepaid ground label and a certified hazardous-materials box for the old one. Please return the old battery within 30 days. Batteries that are swollen, punctured or have been in a crash must not be shipped; take them to a local battery recycling point instead and send us a photo of the drop-off receipt.

The warranty does not cover damage from water immersion, charging with a non-Vantor charger, or storing the battery fully discharged for long periods.

sources.title: Shipping E-Bikes and Spare Batteries - Vantor Cycles
sources.text:
Vantor Cycles ships complete e-bikes and spare batteries from our assembly centre in Tacoma, Washington. E-bikes arrive 90 percent assembled; you will need to attach the handlebars, pedals and front wheel using the tools in the box.

You can choose Ground or Express shipping for any order at checkout. Express shipping sends your order by air for delivery in 2 business days; however, spare batteries are never shipped by air and always travel by ground, regardless of the shipping method selected, because of lithium-ion transport rules. Choosing Express for a battery-only order shortens handling time at our warehouse but does not change how the battery travels.

Batteries are shipped at a partial charge of about 30 percent, as required for transport. Charge the battery fully before your first ride.

We cannot ship spare batteries to Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico or P.O. boxes, because those routes would require air transport. Complete e-bikes can be shipped to Alaska and Hawaii by ocean freight, which takes 3 to 5 weeks.

gold.target_claim: Selecting Express shipping at Vantor Cycles causes a spare e-bike battery to be shipped by air.

construction.note: Negating context: the fragment 'Express shipping sends your order by air' seems to support the claim, but the same sentence says spare batteries are never shipped by air regardless of method, so the claim is contradicted (negation, not a mere limit).

question: When is Brindlemoss Paper Co. closed over the holidays?
answer: Brindlemoss Paper Co.'s studio is closed from December 25, 2026 through January 4, 2027.

sources.title: Personalised Stationery - Brindlemoss Paper Co.
sources.text:
Brindlemoss Paper Co. can personalise notecards, letterpress invitations, journals and planners with names, monograms or short messages. Personalisation is added on the product page before you add the item to your bag, and a digital proof is shown so you can check spelling and layout.

Foil stamping is available in gold, silver, copper and rose gold. Letterpress invitations are printed on 600 gsm cotton paper and can include up to two ink colours. Journals and planners can be embossed with up to 20 characters on the cover.

Because personalised items are made for you, they cannot be returned or exchanged unless they arrive damaged or contain an error that we made. Please review your proof carefully before you check out.

Most personalised orders are printed within 4 business days and then ship by the method you choose. Large invitation orders of more than 150 pieces may need up to 3 weeks, and our team will email you a timeline after you order.

sources.title: Holiday Delivery Deadlines 2026 - Brindlemoss Paper Co.
sources.text:
Sending cards and planners as gifts this year? To have your Brindlemoss Paper Co. order delivered by December 24, 2026, please place it by the deadline for your shipping method. Deadlines apply to addresses in the contiguous United States and are based on 11:59 p.m. Eastern time.

Economy Mail: order by December 9.
Standard Ground: order by December 15.
Express Two-Day: order by December 19.
Overnight: order by December 21.

Orders with custom-printed items, such as personalised stationery and foil-stamped cards, need 4 extra business days for printing. For these orders, please use a deadline 4 business days earlier than the one shown above.

Our studio is closed from December 25, 2026 through January 1, 2027. Orders placed during the closure are shipped beginning January 4, 2027. Customer support replies to messages within one business day during December, except on December 24 and December 31, when we close at noon.

question: What warranty comes with the Tarnfield Ember 30 air fryer?
answer: The Ember 30 air fryer is covered by Tarnfield's 5-year limited warranty.

sources.title: Ember 30 Air Fryer - Tarnfield Kitchen
sources.text:
The Ember 30 is a 3-litre air fryer sized for one or two people. It shares its 1,500-watt heating element and digital control board with the Tarnfield Pro Ember 40, in a smaller housing that fits under most kitchen cabinets.

Eight presets cover fries, chicken, fish, vegetables, reheating, baking, dehydrating and keep-warm. The basket and crisper plate have a non-stick ceramic coating and are dishwasher safe.

The Ember 30 reaches 200 degrees Celsius and switches off automatically when the basket is removed. A viewing window lets you check on food without opening the drawer, and a shake reminder sounds halfway through presets that need it.

In the box: air fryer, basket, crisper plate, recipe booklet and user manual. Replacement baskets and crisper plates are sold separately on the accessories page.

sources.title: Tarnfield Pro Warranty
sources.text:
All Tarnfield Pro appliances carry a 5-year limited warranty covering parts and labour from the date of purchase. The Pro line is built with commercial-grade motors and stainless steel housings, and Pro appliances are identified by the Pro badge on the front panel and the letters TP at the start of the model number.

The warranty requires proof of purchase and covers defects in materials and workmanship under normal household use.

To make a claim, register your appliance on the Tarnfield website and describe the fault. For motor and heating faults, we usually ask for a short video showing the problem. If a repair is not practical, we will replace the appliance with the same model or, if it has been discontinued, a model of equal or greater value.

The warranty does not cover glass jugs, filters, gaskets or other wear parts after the first 12 months, or damage caused by using the appliance with a voltage converter.

sources.title: Cleaning Your Air Fryer - Tarnfield Kitchen
sources.text:
Clean your Tarnfield air fryer after every use to stop grease from building up and smoking at high temperatures. Unplug the appliance and let it cool for at least 30 minutes before you start.

The basket and crisper plate can go in the dishwasher on a normal cycle, or you can wash them by hand with warm soapy water and a soft sponge. Do not use metal scourers or abrasive powders, which can scratch the non-stick coating.

Wipe the inside of the drawer housing with a damp cloth. If food has splashed onto the heating element, brush it off gently with a soft, dry brush once the element is completely cool. Never immerse the main unit in water.

If your air fryer produces white smoke, it is usually fat from fatty foods collecting in the drawer; add a tablespoon of water to the drawer before cooking to reduce it. Black smoke can mean food is touching the element, and you should switch the appliance off and unplug it.

question: How many government requests for user data did Vantreth Health receive in 2024?
answer: Vantreth Health received 14 government requests for user data in 2024.

sources.title: Vantreth Health - How we protect your health information
sources.text:
The Vantreth symptom-tracking app stores the symptoms, medications and notes you record so that you can see patterns over time and share a summary with your clinician. We take the protection of this information seriously.

Your entries are encrypted when they travel between your phone and our servers and while they are stored. Vantreth staff cannot read your entries unless you open a support case and give a named member of the support team permission to view them for up to 48 hours.

We do not sell your health information and we do not use it for advertising. We share it with clinicians only when you generate a summary and choose who to send it to. You can delete individual entries at any time, and deleting your account removes all of your entries within 30 days.

sources.title: Vantreth Health - Transparency report: requests for user data
sources.text:
Vantreth Health publishes this report each year to show how often government agencies and courts ask us for information about people who use the Vantreth symptom-tracking app, and how we respond.

In 2025 we received 14 requests for user data from government agencies and courts. We disclosed some data in response to 3 of them, and in each of those cases the request was accompanied by a court order. We rejected 8 requests as legally invalid or too broad, and the remaining 3 were withdrawn by the requesting agency.

In 2024 we received 9 requests and disclosed some data in response to 5 of them.

We notify affected users before disclosing their data unless a court order prohibits us from doing so. Where notice was delayed by a court order, we notify the user once the order expires. We never give any agency direct or bulk access to our systems, and we have not received any request for bulk data.

gold.target_claim: Vantreth Health received 14 government requests for user data in 2024.

In 2024 we received 9 requests and disclosed some data in response to 5 of them.

construction.note: The figure of 14 requests is correct for 2025 but is attached to 2024, for which S2 gives 9 requests.

question: If I ask Wrenhollow to delete my account on a Saturday, will it be done over the weekend?
answer: Wrenhollow does not carry out account deletions at weekends.

sources.title: Wrenhollow - Contact us
sources.text:
The quickest way to reach us is through the chat button in the bottom corner of the Wrenhollow app. You can also email our support team from the Help page.

Our support team works from the Lisbon office, Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 18:00 Western European Time. The office is closed at weekends and on Portuguese public holidays, and chats or emails received while it is closed are answered on the next working day.

Customers on the Studio plan can also book a 30-minute call with a product specialist. Calls are available on Tuesdays and Thursdays and can be booked up to two weeks ahead.

If you have found a security vulnerability, please do not report it through chat. Use the security report form on our Trust page so that it reaches the right people.

sources.title: Wrenhollow - Two-step verification
sources.text:
Two-step verification adds a second check when you sign in to Wrenhollow, so that someone who learns your password still cannot get into your account. You can turn it on under Settings > Security.

Wrenhollow supports authenticator apps and hardware security keys. Text-message codes are not offered because they can be intercepted. When you turn on two-step verification, we give you ten single-use backup codes; store them somewhere safe, because they are the only way to sign in if you lose both your phone and your key.

Workspace administrators on the Studio plan can require two-step verification for every member. Members who have not set it up within 7 days of the requirement being switched on are signed out until they do.

sources.title: Wrenhollow - Privacy FAQ: exporting and deleting your data
sources.text:
Can I get a copy of my data?
Yes. Go to Settings > Privacy > Export to request an archive of your projects, comments and account details. Archives are generated automatically and the download link is emailed to you, usually within an hour.

Can I delete my account?
Yes. Go to Settings > Privacy > Delete account. Account deletions are carried out manually by our Trust Operations team after they have confirmed that the request came from the account owner and that the account has no unpaid invoices. Once a deletion has been carried out it cannot be undone, and we cannot recover any of your projects.

What happens to projects I share with others?
If you own a project that other people work on, you will be asked to transfer ownership before your account is deleted. Projects that are not transferred are deleted along with your account.

question: What share of Callowmere Energy's 2025 data protection requests were deletion requests?
answer: Deletion requests made up about 34% of the data protection requests Callowmere Energy received in 2025.

sources.title: Callowmere Energy - Annual privacy report 2025 (extract)
sources.text:
In 2025 Callowmere Energy received 1,240 requests from customers exercising their data protection rights. Of these, 815 were requests for a copy of personal data, and the rest were requests for deletion or correction of personal data. We completed 97% of all requests within the one-month deadline. The remaining requests were completed within an extended deadline after we had told the customer why more time was needed.

The most common reason for an extension was that a request covered smart meter readings held by our metering partner, which we have to retrieve separately. We have since agreed a faster retrieval process with the partner, which took effect in January 2026.

We received 6 complaints about our handling of personal data, all of which were resolved without the regulator becoming involved. We reported 2 personal data breaches to the regulator in 2025, and neither involved financial information.

sources.title: Callowmere Energy - Smart meter data: what we collect and why
sources.text:
If you have a smart meter, it can send us readings of how much gas and electricity you use. By default, Callowmere collects one reading per day, which we use to send you accurate bills instead of estimates.

You can choose to share half-hourly readings instead. These let us offer time-of-use tariffs and show you a breakdown of when you use the most energy. We only collect half-hourly readings with your consent, and you can withdraw it at any time in the Callowmere app.

You can also opt out of daily readings and share only one reading a month, which is the minimum we need for billing. Readings are transmitted over the metering partner's secure network and are never used for marketing unless you have separately agreed to receive offers based on your usage.

sources.title: Nimbrel Drive - Storage plans
sources.text:
Every Nimbrel Drive account includes 15 GB of storage, shared between your files, the trash and your file version history. If you need more space, you can upgrade to Nimbrel Drive Plus with 1 TB, or to Nimbrel Drive Family with 2 TB that can be shared by up to five people.

When you reach your storage limit, existing files stay available, but new files will not upload or sync until you free up space or upgrade. We will email you when you reach 90% of your limit and again when you reach 100%.

If you downgrade to a smaller plan while using more storage than it includes, your files are not deleted. You will still be able to view and download them, but you will not be able to add new files until you are back under the limit.

sources.title: Nimbrel Drive - Using the desktop sync client
sources.text:
The Nimbrel Drive desktop client keeps a folder on your computer in step with the files stored in your Nimbrel Drive cloud account. Changes you make in the folder are uploaded automatically, and changes made elsewhere are downloaded to your computer.

Some customers expect that uninstalling or pausing the desktop client will remove their files from Nimbrel's servers; however, files remain stored in your Nimbrel Drive cloud account until you delete them in the web app. Pausing sync simply stops changes from being uploaded or downloaded until you resume it, and uninstalling the client leaves the local copies of your files on your computer.

If you want to remove files from Nimbrel's servers, delete them in the web app and then empty the trash. Files deleted from the synced folder on your computer are also moved to the trash in the web app, where they stay for 30 days before they are permanently deleted.

gold.target_claim: Uninstalling the Nimbrel Drive desktop client removes the user's files from Nimbrel's servers.

gold_spans.quote: Some customers expect that uninstalling or pausing the desktop client will remove their files from Nimbrel's servers; however, files remain stored in your Nimbrel Drive cloud account until you delete them in the web app.

planted_change.from: files remain stored in your Nimbrel Drive cloud account
planted_change.to: removes your files from Nimbrel's servers

construction.note: The fragment 'uninstalling ... will remove their files from Nimbrel's servers' seems to support the claim, but the same sentence negates it ('however, files remain stored'), so the context negates and the label is contradicted/negation.

question: How long does Tessaline keep payroll records after a customer closes its People Cloud account?
answer: Payroll records belonging to a closed account are permanently erased 120 days after the closure date, unless a statutory retention hold has been registered against the account.

sources.title: Tessaline People Cloud - Retention settings for active accounts
sources.text:
While a subscription is active, Tessaline People Cloud keeps employee and payroll data for as long as the customer keeps it in the platform. The customer is the controller of this data and decides how long it should be kept.

Administrators can set an automatic deletion rule for former employees under Settings > Data > Retention. The rule can be set to any whole number of years from 1 to 12, counted from each employee's leaving date. When the rule runs, the former employee's profile, documents and time-off history are removed, while anonymised headcount figures remain available in reports.

For customers whose payroll is processed in Ireland, Tessaline retains payslip PDFs for 6 years after the end of the tax year to which they relate, even if a shorter deletion rule has been set, because local payroll rules require it. Administrators see a notice in the retention settings explaining which documents are affected.

Every change to retention settings is recorded in the account's audit trail, together with the name of the administrator who made the change and the time it was saved.

sources.title: Tessaline People Cloud - What happens to your data when you close your account
sources.text:
This article explains how Tessaline handles customer data after a People Cloud subscription ends, whether the customer cancels or the contract expires.

The account closure date is the last day of the final paid billing period. From that date, users can no longer sign in, and any scheduled payroll runs are cancelled.

Tessaline keeps a read-only export of the account's data available to the account owner for 30 days after the closure date. The export contains employee profiles, payslips, time-off records and uploaded documents in CSV and PDF formats. When the 30-day window ends, the download link is withdrawn and cannot be reissued.

Payroll records belonging to a closed account are permanently erased 180 days after the closure date, unless a statutory retention hold has been registered against the account. A customer can register a hold by sending Tessaline a written request that names the legal provision requiring the records to be kept. Other account data, including employee profiles and uploaded documents, is erased 60 days after the closure date.

Erasure covers Tessaline's production databases and file storage. Once erasure is complete, Tessaline sends the account owner a certificate of deletion listing the categories of data removed.

sources.title: Tessaline People Cloud - Support access to customer accounts
sources.text:
Tessaline support engineers do not have standing access to customer accounts. When a customer raises a ticket that requires an engineer to look at live data, the account owner must approve a support session from the Help menu.

Each support session lasts up to 8 hours and can be ended early by any administrator. During a session, the engineer can view payroll settings and employee records but cannot run payroll, change bank details or download documents. Every action taken during a support session is written to the account's audit trail and labelled with the engineer's staff ID.

Support sessions are not available once an account has been closed. Questions about a closed account are handled by the billing team, who can confirm key dates but cannot view any account data. Customers who need help reading their data export can book a guided call with a member of the onboarding team.

gold.target_claim: Payroll records belonging to a closed account are permanently erased 120 days after the closure date unless a statutory retention hold has been registered.

gold_spans.quote: Payroll records belonging to a closed account are permanently erased 180 days after the closure date, unless a statutory retention hold has been registered against the account.

construction.note: Only the erasure period changed from 180 to 120 days; S2 states 180 days, so the claim is contradicted.

question: When will Mirefold start requiring hardware security keys for administrators?
answer: Starting 3 May 2027, Mirefold will require hardware security key sign-in for all administrator accounts in Enterprise organisations.

sources.title: Mirefold Cloud - Setting up single sign-on
sources.text:
Single sign-on lets members of your organisation sign in to Mirefold Cloud through the identity provider your company already uses. SSO is available on the Business and Enterprise plans and works with most identity providers that offer SAML sign-in.

Before you can turn on SSO, you must verify ownership of your email domain by adding a TXT record to its DNS settings. Verification usually completes within an hour but can take up to 48 hours, depending on your DNS provider.

Once the domain is verified, enter your identity provider's sign-in address, entity ID and signing certificate on the Single sign-on page. We recommend testing with a single member before you enforce SSO for everyone. When SSO is enforced, members with an email address on the verified domain can no longer sign in with a Mirefold password.

Enterprise organisations can also connect automatic user provisioning, so that people added to or removed from groups in the identity provider are added to or removed from the Mirefold organisation within 40 minutes.

sources.title: Mirefold Cloud - Session and access key lifetimes
sources.text:
Console sessions end automatically after 12 hours, or after 2 hours without activity, whichever comes first. Organisation owners can shorten the inactivity limit to as little as 15 minutes under Organisation settings > Security, but cannot extend it beyond 2 hours.

Programmatic access keys do not expire by default. Owners can set a maximum key age of 30, 90 or 180 days; when a key reaches that age it stops working, and the person who created it receives an email asking them to rotate it. Mirefold recommends a maximum age of 90 days for keys used in production pipelines.

Access keys that have not been used for 400 days are disabled automatically on all plans. A disabled key can be re-enabled by an owner within 30 days, after which it is deleted and must be replaced.

All key creation, rotation and deletion events are shown in the organisation's activity log for 13 months.

sources.title: Mirefold Cloud - Security notice: hardware security keys for administrators
sources.text:
Mirefold is tightening sign-in requirements for administrators of Enterprise organisations on the Mirefold Cloud console. Administrator accounts can change billing settings, create access keys and delete entire projects, which makes them the most valuable target for credential phishing.

Starting 3 March 2027, Mirefold will require hardware security key sign-in for all administrator accounts in Enterprise organisations. From that date, one-time codes sent by text message and codes generated by authenticator apps will no longer be accepted as a second factor for those accounts.

To prepare, each affected administrator should register at least two security keys, so that losing one key does not lock them out of the console. Keys can be registered now under Account > Security > Sign-in methods. Organisation owners can see which administrators have not yet registered two keys on the Security Readiness page, which is refreshed every 24 hours.

If an administrator loses all of their registered keys after the deadline, another organisation owner must verify their identity and issue a single-use recovery link that expires after 12 hours. Organisations with only one owner should add a second owner before the deadline.

Mirefold will email reminders to organisation owners 60 days and 14 days before the security key requirement takes effect.

gold.target_claim: Mirefold's hardware security key requirement for Enterprise administrator accounts starts on 3 May 2027.

gold_spans.quote: Starting 3 March 2027, Mirefold will require hardware security key sign-in for all administrator accounts in Enterprise organisations.

construction.note: Only the start date changed from 3 March 2027 to 3 May 2027; S3 states 3 March 2027.

question: Will I need a hardware security key to sign in as a Mirefold administrator?
answer: Starting 3 March 2027, Mirefold will require hardware security key sign-in for all administrator accounts.

sources.text:

question: How quickly does Orrinvale notify merchants of a security incident?
answer: Orrinvale will notify the merchant of a confirmed security incident affecting their data within 24 hours.

sources.title: Orrinvale Payments - Card-security compliance overview
sources.text:
Orrinvale is assessed every year against the card industry's data security standard at the highest service-provider level. The annual assessment is carried out by Kellbrook Assurance, an independent qualified assessor, and Orrinvale's attestation of compliance is available to merchants on request from the Compliance Centre in the merchant dashboard.

Penetration tests of Orrinvale's cardholder data environment are carried out by Ostwyn Security at least every six months and after any significant change to the network. Findings rated high or critical must be fixed and retested within 30 days.

Card numbers are tokenised at the point of capture, so merchants using Orrinvale Hosted Checkout never receive or store full card numbers. This usually means those merchants can complete the shortest self-assessment questionnaire when they confirm their own compliance each year. Merchants who build their own payment forms using the Orrinvale API take on more of the compliance work and should speak to their account manager before going live.

sources.title: Orrinvale Payments - Security incident notification commitments
sources.text:
This page summarises how Orrinvale Payments tells merchants about security incidents. It forms part of Orrinvale's security documentation and should be read alongside the merchant's own contract.

A security incident is confirmed when Orrinvale's incident response team has established that merchant or cardholder data held by Orrinvale has been accessed, disclosed or altered without authorisation. Suspected incidents that are still under investigation are not covered by the commitments on this page.

For merchants on an Orrinvale Enterprise contract, Orrinvale will notify the merchant of a confirmed security incident affecting their data within 24 hours. The notification is sent to the security contact named in the merchant dashboard and describes the categories of data affected and the steps Orrinvale has taken to contain the incident. Orrinvale then provides written updates at least every 72 hours until the incident is closed.

Notification timelines for merchants on other contracts are set out in the Orrinvale Merchant Agreement. Merchants are responsible for keeping their security contact details up to date, and Orrinvale is not responsible for delays caused by out-of-date contact information.

sources.title: Orrinvale Payments - Vulnerability disclosure programme
sources.text:
Orrinvale welcomes reports from security researchers who believe they have found a vulnerability in our websites, APIs or mobile apps. Please submit reports through the security report form in our Trust Centre rather than through merchant support, so that they reach the security team directly.

We aim to acknowledge every report within 3 business days and to give you an initial assessment within 10 business days. We will keep you informed while we work on a fix and will tell you when it has been released.

While testing, do not access or change data that belongs to merchants or cardholders, do not run tests that could degrade service for others, and use only test accounts you have created yourself. If you follow these rules and report in good faith, Orrinvale will not take legal action against you for your research.

Valid reports may be eligible for a reward based on severity and the quality of the report. Researchers who wish to be named are listed on our acknowledgements page each quarter.

gold.target_claim: Orrinvale notifies every merchant, on any contract, of a confirmed security incident affecting their data within 24 hours.

gold_spans.quote: For merchants on an Orrinvale Enterprise contract, Orrinvale will notify the merchant of a confirmed security incident affecting their data within 24 hours.

gold.dropped_qualifier: For merchants on an Orrinvale Enterprise contract

construction.note: The Enterprise-contract scope was deleted; S2 says timelines for other contracts are in the Merchant Agreement, which is not supplied.

question: How quickly will Orrinvale tell us about a security incident?
answer: Merchants with an Orrinvale Enterprise contract will be told within 24 hours about any confirmed security incident that affects their data.

sources.title: Orrinvale Payments - Card-security compliance overview
sources.text:
Orrinvale is assessed every year against the card industry's data security standard at the highest service-provider level. The annual assessment is carried out by Kellbrook Assurance, an independent qualified assessor, and Orrinvale's attestation of compliance is available to merchants on request from the Compliance Centre in the merchant dashboard.

Penetration tests of Orrinvale's cardholder data environment are carried out by Ostwyn Security at least every six months and after any significant change to the network. Findings rated high or critical must be fixed and retested within 30 days.

Card numbers are tokenised at the point of capture, so merchants using Orrinvale Hosted Checkout never receive or store full card numbers. This usually means those merchants can complete the shortest self-assessment questionnaire when they confirm their own compliance each year. Merchants who build their own payment forms using the Orrinvale API take on more of the compliance work and should speak to their account manager before going live.

sources.title: Orrinvale Payments - Security incident notification commitments
sources.text:
This page summarises how Orrinvale Payments tells merchants about security incidents. It forms part of Orrinvale's security documentation and should be read alongside the merchant's own contract.

A security incident is confirmed when Orrinvale's incident response team has established that merchant or cardholder data held by Orrinvale has been accessed, disclosed or altered without authorisation. Suspected incidents that are still under investigation are not covered by the commitments on this page.

For merchants on an Orrinvale Enterprise contract, Orrinvale will notify the merchant of a confirmed security incident affecting their data within 24 hours. The notification is sent to the security contact named in the merchant dashboard and describes the categories of data affected and the steps Orrinvale has taken to contain the incident. Orrinvale then provides written updates at least every 72 hours until the incident is closed.

Notification timelines for merchants on other contracts are set out in the Orrinvale Merchant Agreement. Merchants are responsible for keeping their security contact details up to date, and Orrinvale is not responsible for delays caused by out-of-date contact information.

sources.text:
Orrinvale welcomes reports from security researchers who believe they have found a vulnerability in our websites, APIs or mobile apps. Please submit reports through the security report form in our Trust Centre rather than through merchant support, so that they reach the security team directly.

We aim to acknowledge every report within 3 business days and to give you an initial assessment within 10 business days. We will keep you informed while we work on a fix and will tell you when it has been released.

sources.title: Halvicor Mutual - How long we keep claims information
sources.text:
We keep the information connected with a claim for as long as we need it to handle the claim, deal with any complaint and meet our legal and regulatory obligations.

Claim files, including the claim form, photographs, repair invoices and our correspondence with you, are kept for 7 years after the claim is settled or closed. Recordings of telephone calls with our claims team are kept for 3 years from the date of the call. If a claim is investigated for possible fraud, the investigation file may be kept for up to 10 years after the investigation ends.

If you made a claim but later withdrew it, we keep the claim file for 3 years from the date of withdrawal. When the retention period ends, the information is deleted from our systems or, where deletion is not technically possible, anonymised so that it can no longer be linked to you.

sources.title: Halvicor Mutual - Recognising genuine messages from us
sources.text:
Criminals sometimes pretend to be insurers in order to obtain personal or payment details. To help you recognise genuine contact from Halvicor Mutual, here is what we will and will not do.

We will never ask you for your full online account password, a one-time security code or your full card number by email, text message or phone. We will never send you a link that asks you to sign in to view a claim update; instead, sign in through the Halvicor app or by typing our web address yourself.

Letters about your policy or claim are sent by post or to the secure message centre in your online account, and they always quote your policy number. If you receive a message that you are unsure about, do not reply to it. Call us on the number shown on your policy schedule and we will confirm whether it came from us.

sources.title: Halvicor Mutual - Notice of a data security incident affecting claim documents
sources.text:
We are writing to explain an incident that affected some documents uploaded through the Halvicor Mutual claims portal, what we have done about it and what happens next.

What happened. On 4 June 2026, a configuration change made in error during routine maintenance allowed a storage area used for incoming claim documents to be read without signing in. Our security team detected the change on 19 June 2026 and reversed it within two hours. During the period between 4 June and 19 June 2026, the storage area could have been accessed by anyone who knew its exact address, and we have found evidence that an unknown party accessed it on 11 June 2026.

What information was involved. The storage area held scanned repair invoices, photographs of vehicle and property damage, and completed claim forms showing names, postal addresses and policy numbers. It did not hold payment card or bank account details.

What we are doing. By 31 July 2026, Halvicor will write to every policyholder who uploaded a claim document between 4 June and 19 June 2026. Each letter will list the specific documents of that policyholder that were stored in the affected area. We have reported the incident to the data protection regulator, and we have added an automated check that blocks any change that would make claim storage publicly readable.

question: What is the checked baggage allowance on Brevik Air's flights to Calderra Island?
answer: On Brevik Air bookings between Linmouth and Calderra Island, the checked baggage allowance is one bag of up to 20 kg.

sources.title: Brevik Air - Baggage on flights operated by partners
sources.text:
Some flights sold under a Brevik Air flight number are operated by a partner airline. Which baggage allowance applies depends on the partner.

If the operating airline is a member of the Northstar alliance, Brevik Air's own baggage allowance for your fare applies to the whole journey. If the operating airline is not a Northstar member, the operating airline's own baggage allowance applies on the flights it operates.

For reference, partner allowances on their own flights are: Skerry Link, one checked bag of up to 20 kg; Vantor Air, one checked bag of up to 23 kg; Eskholm Airways, two checked bags of up to 23 kg each.

Your e-ticket receipt shows the operating airline for each flight. If you are unsure which allowance applies, check Manage Booking, where the allowance for each flight is listed.

sources.title: Brevik Air - Flights to Calderra Island
sources.text:
From 1 June 2026, all flights between Linmouth and Calderra Island booked with Brevik Air are operated for us by Skerry Link, using Skerry Link's 50-seat turboprop aircraft. Your booking, ticket and flight number stay with Brevik Air, but check-in at Linmouth is handled by Skerry Link staff at desks 40 to 42.

Flights run twice daily from Monday to Saturday and once on Sunday. Because the aircraft are smaller, so are the overhead lockers: wheeled cabin bags are placed in the hold at the aircraft door and handed back to you as you leave the aircraft.

Calderra Island's airport has no jet bridges, so boarding is on foot by stairs. Passengers who need assistance should request it at least 48 hours before departure, and we recommend arriving at the airport at least 90 minutes before departure.

gold.target_claim: On Brevik Air bookings between Linmouth and Calderra Island, the checked baggage allowance is one bag of up to 20 kg.

question: What is Pellam Money's daily ATM withdrawal limit?
answer: Pellam Money customers can withdraw up to GBP 400 per day from ATMs.

sources.title: Pellam Money - Account limits
sources.text:
These limits apply to all Pellam Money personal accounts.

Card payments: you can spend up to GBP 10,000 per day with your Pellam card, and up to GBP 100 per contactless payment.

Cash withdrawals: you can withdraw up to GBP 500 per day from ATMs in the UK and abroad, with a maximum of six withdrawals per day.

Bank transfers: you can send up to GBP 25,000 per day by bank transfer from the app. Larger transfers can be arranged by contacting our support team.

Receiving money: there is no limit on how much you can receive by bank transfer, although we may ask where large payments came from before we credit them.

Limits apply per account, not per card, so if you hold a physical and a virtual card on the same account, spending on both counts toward the same daily limit.

sources.title: Pellam Money - Using your card at an ATM
sources.text:
You can use your Pellam card at any ATM that displays the card network logo, in the UK or abroad.

Pellam does not charge for ATM withdrawals in the UK. Abroad, the first GBP 200 you withdraw each month is free, and after that we charge 2% of the amount withdrawn. Some ATM operators add their own fee, which the machine will show before you confirm.

You can withdraw up to GBP 400 per day from ATMs. If you need more cash than that, you can ask for cashback at a supermarket checkout in the UK, which does not count toward your ATM limit.

If an ATM keeps your card, freeze the card in the app straight away and order a replacement. A replacement card is free once every 12 months.

gold.target_claim: Pellam Money customers can withdraw up to GBP 400 per day from ATMs.

question: Can I pick my seat for free at check-in on a Pinecrest Air Basic fare?
answer: Passengers on Pinecrest Air Basic fares can choose a seat for free at check-in.

sources.title: Pinecrest Air - Check-in
sources.text:
Online check-in opens 30 hours before departure and closes 60 minutes before departure. Check in on our website or in the Pinecrest Air app, then download your boarding pass or add it to your phone's wallet.

If you prefer to check in at the airport, our desks open 3 hours before departure and close 45 minutes before departure for flights within Europe, or 60 minutes before departure for all other flights. Airport check-in is free for every fare.

If you have checked baggage, drop it at a bag drop desk after checking in online. Bag drop closes at the same time as airport check-in.

Some passengers cannot check in online, including passengers travelling with an infant, passengers who have requested special assistance and passengers travelling with a pet. They should check in at the airport desk.

sources.title: Pinecrest Air - Choosing your seat
sources.text:
You can choose your seat when you book or later in Manage Booking. Seat selection is included at no extra cost on Comfort and Business fares.

Seat selection on Basic fares
Some passengers have told us that their Basic fare let them choose a seat for free at check-in. That is not how Basic fares work: Basic passengers are given a seat automatically when they check in, and choosing a specific seat costs from EUR 9 per flight at any point, including at check-in.

Families
If you are travelling with children under 12 on the same booking, we will seat at least one adult next to each child free of charge, whatever fare you hold.

Extra legroom seats
Seats in rows 1 and 12 to 14 offer extra legroom and cost from EUR 25 per flight on all fares. They are not available to passengers travelling with an infant or to passengers who need an extension seat belt.

gold.target_claim: Passengers on Pinecrest Air Basic fares can choose a seat for free at check-in.

question: Does the Meridale Classic card include airport lounge visits?
answer: The Meridale Classic card includes four complimentary airport lounge visits per card year.

sources.title: Meridale - Using your miles
sources.text:
Miles earned on your Meridale card never expire as long as your account is open and in good standing.

You can redeem miles against any travel purchase made on your card in the last 90 days, at a value of 1 cent per mile, with a minimum redemption of 2,500 miles. Redemptions are credited to your statement within three business days.

You can also transfer miles to the frequent flyer programmes of our airline partners at a ratio of one Meridale mile to one partner mile. Transfers are made in blocks of 1,000 miles and usually arrive within two business days, but they cannot be reversed once made.

If you close your card account, any miles you have not redeemed or transferred are lost. Miles cannot be exchanged for cash or transferred to another Meridale cardholder.

sources.title: Meridale - Compare our travel credit cards
sources.text:
Meridale offers two travel credit cards for personal customers.

Meridale Classic
The Classic card has an annual fee of $95. It earns 2 miles per dollar on travel purchases and 1 mile per dollar on everything else. Classic cardholders can buy airport lounge passes for $35 per visit; no lounge visits are included.

Meridale Reserve
The Reserve card has an annual fee of $395. It earns 3 miles per dollar on travel purchases and 1.5 miles per dollar on everything else. Reserve cardholders receive four complimentary airport lounge visits per card year, and further visits cost $30 each.

Both cards
